meta.title: 学位英语高频单词 · 全量分层记忆卡
meta.source: 钉题库《学位英语高频单词打卡30天》(1877词)
meta.note: 完整六步卡(难词127)+轻量卡(简单词,词义/联想/例句)+跳过(最基础功能词)。

full_cards.meaning: 在（到）国外，在（到）海外；传开
full_cards.why: 阅读/翻译高频，表"出国"语境反复出现
full_cards.etymology: a-（在…上）+ broad（宽广）→ 在宽广的海那一边 → 国外
full_cards.mnemonic: a + broad（宽）→ 出了国门，路一下子"变宽"了、天也变宽了 → 出国。画面：一步跨过大海，眼前豁然开朗
full_cards.example: study abroad · She wants to study abroad next year.（她想明年出国留学。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"国外"+ 搭配 study abroad
full_cards.nuance: abroad 是副词，前面不加 in/to（go abroad，不是 go to abroad）；区别 aboard（在船/机上）

full_cards.meaning: 缺席的；缺乏的；漫不经心
full_cards.why: 语法题常考 be absent from 搭配
full_cards.etymology: ab-（离开）+ sent（=essence 在场）→ 人离开现场 → 缺席
full_cards.mnemonic: ab（离开）+ sent（send 送走）→ 把自己"送走"了、人不在 → 缺席。画面：点名时人已经飘到门外
full_cards.example: be absent from · He was absent from class yesterday.（他昨天缺课了。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"缺席"+ 搭配 be absent from
full_cards.nuance: absent from（缺席某场合），不是 absent in；反义词 present（出席的）

full_cards.meaning: 事故；意外的事，偶然的事
full_cards.why: 完形/阅读高频，by accident 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: ac-（朝向）+ cid（落）+ -ent → 突然落到头上 → 意外、事故
full_cards.mnemonic: ac-cid-ent 中间藏 cid（摔落）→ 东西突然"砸"下来 → 意外事故。画面：一块砖从天而降
full_cards.example: by accident · I met him by accident on the street.（我碰巧在街上遇到他。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"事故/意外"+ 搭配 by accident
full_cards.nuance: by accident（偶然）= by chance；accident 是意外事故，incident 是（小）事件

full_cards.why: 阅读里描述味道/化学，也引申"尖刻"
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 acidus（酸的），与 acrid（辛辣）同源
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"爱吸的"→ 酸得让人"爱吸"一口气、龇牙咧嘴。画面：咬一口柠檬，酸到倒吸凉气
full_cards.example: acid rain · Acid rain harms the environment.（酸雨危害环境。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"酸"+ 搭配 acid rain
full_cards.nuance: acid 作形容词还引申"尖刻的"（an acid remark 尖刻的话）

full_cards.why: be eager to do 是写作/翻译高频句型
full_cards.etymology: 源自古法语 aigre（锐利的、急切的）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"一个儿"→ 妈妈望子成龙，眼睛都"一个劲地"盯着 → 热切渴望。画面：伸长脖子往前探
full_cards.example: be eager to · The students are eager to learn.（学生们渴望学习。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"渴望的"+ 搭配 be eager to do
full_cards.nuance: be eager to do（渴望做）、be eager for（渴望某物）；同义 keen on，但 eager 更书面

full_cards.why: 环保话题作文高频词
full_cards.etymology: 中世纪英语，原指"禽鸟内脏"，引申为垃圾
full_cards.mnemonic: gar（谐音"嘎"）+ bage → 垃圾桶"嘎嘣"一声合上盖 → 垃圾。画面：扔完垃圾盖子弹回的声音
full_cards.example: garbage can · Please throw it into the garbage can.（请把它扔进垃圾桶。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"垃圾"+ 搭配 garbage can
full_cards.nuance: garbage（美，生活垃圾）、rubbish（英）；rubbish 还引申"废话"（口语）

full_cards.why: lack of 是高频短语，翻译/写作常考
full_cards.etymology: 中古英语 lak（不足），与 leak（漏）同源
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"赖克"→ 东西"赖"着不给你、缺货 → 缺乏。画面：货架上空空如也
full_cards.example: lack of · The plants died for lack of water.（植物因缺水而死。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"缺乏"+ 搭配 lack of / be lacking in
full_cards.nuance: lack of（名词短语）+ 名词；lack 作动词直接接宾语，不加 of（He lacks money.）

full_cards.why: 写作"获取"类动词高频，比 get 正式
full_cards.etymology: ob-（加强）+ tain（抓住，同 ten-）→ 用力抓住 → 获得
full_cards.mnemonic: tain = 抓（contain 里也藏着抓）→ ob-tain 就是"把它抓到手" → 获得。画面：伸手把目标稳稳抓住
full_cards.example: obtain a degree · You can obtain a degree after three years.（三年后你可获得学位。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"获得"+ 搭配 obtain a degree/information
full_cards.nuance: obtain（正式、通过努力获得）、get（口语）、gain（获得抽象收益）；同根 contain/retain/maintain

full_cards.why: on occasion / on this occasion 是固定搭配考点
full_cards.etymology: oc-（向）+ cas（落下）+ -ion → 事情落到眼前 → 时机、场合
full_cards.mnemonic: oc + cas（谐音"开撕"）+ ion → 重要"场合"上可不能"开撕"。画面：正式晚宴上保持体面
full_cards.example: on this occasion · On this occasion, we should celebrate.（在这个场合，我们应该庆祝。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"场合/时机"+ 搭配 on this occasion
full_cards.nuance: occasion 是可数名词（an occasion）；occasionally（副词）偶然地，不是"在场合上"

full_cards.why: 职场话题高频，区分 salary/wage 是考点
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 salarium（盐钱）→ 古罗马士兵领盐作报酬 → 薪水
full_cards.mnemonic: sal（salt 盐）→ 古罗马发工资是发"盐" → 薪水。画面：古代人扛着一袋盐当工资
full_cards.example: monthly salary · He gets a monthly salary of 5000 yuan.（他月薪五千元。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"薪水"+ 搭配 monthly salary
full_cards.nuance: salary（月薪，白领）、wage（周薪，体力劳动）、pay（统称）；同源 salad（盐拌的沙拉）

full_cards.why: 日常词但易与 tap（水龙头）混淆
full_cards.etymology: 源自古英语 tæppe（狭长的布条）
full_cards.mnemonic: 对比拼写：tape（磁带，多个 e 拖长）vs tap（水龙头，短促）→ 磁带是"长长"的一卷。画面：一长条带子卷成圈
full_cards.example: tape recorder · She listened to the tape recorder.（她听录音机。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"磁带/带子"，并分清 tape / tap
full_cards.nuance: tape（带子、磁带、胶带）、tap（水龙头、轻拍）；tape recorder 录音机

full_cards.why: 年龄话题词，构词清晰易联想
full_cards.etymology: teen（13-19 数字后缀）+ age（年龄）→ 十几岁
full_cards.mnemonic: thirteen 到 nineteen 都带 teen，加上 age → 十几岁的年纪。画面：13-19 岁一排站
full_cards.example: teenage problems · Teenage problems are common in schools.（青少年问题在学校很常见。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"十几岁的"，联想 teen（13-19 都带 teen）
full_cards.nuance: teenage（形容词）、teenager（名词，青少年）；发音重音在前 teen

full_cards.why: 听力/阅读常见，注意与 accident 区分
full_cards.etymology: ac-（加强）+ cent（唱）→ 唱出来的强调 → 重音
full_cards.mnemonic: ac + cent（分币）→ 说话像"分币"轻重不一样 → 重音、口音。画面：说话抑扬顿挫
full_cards.example: foreign accent · He speaks English with a foreign accent.（他说英语带外国口音。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"口音/重音"，区分 accent / accident
full_cards.nuance: accent（口音、重音）、accident（事故）；别只差一个 i/d 就看错

full_cards.why: account for 是高频短语，完形常考
full_cards.etymology: ac-（向）+ count（数）→ 数清楚 → 记账、说明
full_cards.mnemonic: ac + count（数）→ 把一笔笔"数"清楚 → 账户、说明。画面：会计对着账本数数
full_cards.example: account for · The weather accounts for the delay.（天气是延误的原因。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"账户/解释"+ 搭配 account for（解释、占…比例）
full_cards.nuance: account for 有"解释原因"和"占比例"两个意思；bank account 银行账户

full_cards.why: 写作"成就"高频，与 achieve 同根
full_cards.etymology: achieve（完成）+ -ment（名词）→ 完成的事 → 成就
full_cards.mnemonic: a + chieve（=chief 头）+ ment → 干成了"头等"大事 → 成就。画面：登顶领奖台
full_cards.example: a great achievement · Winning the prize is a great achievement.（获奖是巨大成就。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"成就"，联想 achieve + ment
full_cards.nuance: achievement（成就，抽象/具体）、accomplishment 同义但更强调技能；同根 achieve

full_cards.why: 数据/科技话题高频，构词可拆
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 calculus（小石子）→ 古人用小石子计数 → 计算
full_cards.mnemonic: cal + cul + ate → 古人用"小石子"（calculus）一颗颗"吃"（ate）进账本 → 计算。画面：摆石子算数
full_cards.example: calculate the cost · We need to calculate the cost first.（我们需要先计算成本。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"计算"+ 搭配 calculate the cost
full_cards.nuance: calculate（计算、推算）、compute（计算机计算）；calculator 计算器

full_cards.why: on the edge of 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 ecg（锋利的边）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"艾子"→ 刀的"刃"像艾草的叶子一样锋利 → 边缘、刃。画面：刀刃闪着寒光
full_cards.example: on the edge of · The company is on the edge of bankruptcy.（公司濒临破产。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"边缘"+ 搭配 on the edge of
full_cards.nuance: on the edge of（濒临）、at the edge of（在…边缘）；edge 还引申"优势"（have an edge）

full_cards.why: 情感类高频，与 defend 对比记忆
full_cards.etymology: of-（相对）+ fend（打击）→ 反着打 → 冒犯
full_cards.mnemonic: 对比 defend（防守）vs offend（冒犯）→ 一个守、一个攻。画面：说错话把人"得罪"了
full_cards.example: offend sb · I didn't mean to offend you.（我不是故意冒犯你。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"冒犯"，对比 defend（防守）
full_cards.nuance: offend（冒犯）、defend（防守，含 de- 反着挡）；offensive（冒犯的）

full_cards.why: 构词清晰（un- 表反向），易联想
full_cards.etymology: un-（反）+ do（做）→ 把做的还原 → 撤销、解开
full_cards.mnemonic: un + do → 把"做"的反过来 → 撤销、解开。画面：Ctrl+Z 撤销
full_cards.example: undo the damage · Nothing can undo the damage.（什么都无法挽回损失。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"撤销/解开"，联想 un + do
full_cards.nuance: undo（撤销、解开）、undone（未完成的，be left undone）

full_cards.why: in the absence of 是高频短语
full_cards.etymology: absent（缺席的）的名词形式
full_cards.mnemonic: absent（缺席，前面学过）+ -ence → 缺席、缺乏。联想 absent 一家
full_cards.example: in the absence of · In the absence of proof, we can't decide.（缺乏证据时无法定论。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"缺席/缺乏"+ 搭配 in the absence of
full_cards.nuance: absence（缺席、缺乏）、presence（出席、存在）；in the absence of（在缺乏…情况下）

full_cards.why: accept + -able 构词清晰
full_cards.etymology: accept（接受）+ -able（可…的）→ 可接受的
full_cards.mnemonic: accept + able → "能"（able）被"接受"（accept）的 → 可接受的
full_cards.example: acceptable to · The plan is acceptable to everyone.（这个计划大家都接受。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"可接受的"，联想 accept + able
full_cards.nuance: acceptable（可接受的）、accepted（被认可的）；注意拼写 accept 不是 except

full_cards.why: according to 是写作/阅读最高频连接短语之一
full_cards.etymology: accord（一致）+ -ing → 与…一致 → 根据
full_cards.mnemonic: accord（一致）+ ing → 跟它"一致"→ 根据。画面：照着尺子量
full_cards.example: according to · According to the report, the number is rising.（根据报告，数字在上升。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"根据"，联想 accord（一致）
full_cards.nuance: according to 后接名词/代词，不接观点（不说 according to me，说 in my opinion）

full_cards.why: 写作"达成目标"核心动词
full_cards.etymology: a-（到）+ chieve（=chief 头，顶点）→ 到达顶点 → 达到
full_cards.mnemonic: a + chieve（=chief 头）→ 冲到"头"、到顶 → 达成。画面：冲线夺冠
full_cards.example: achieve success · Hard work helps you achieve success.（努力帮你取得成功。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"达成"+ 搭配 achieve success/goal
full_cards.nuance: achieve（达到目标）、reach（到达）、accomplish（完成）；名词 achievement

full_cards.why: have the ability to 是高频句型
full_cards.etymology: able（能干的）+ -ity（名词）→ 能力
full_cards.mnemonic: able + ity → "能"（able）的名词 → 能力
full_cards.example: have the ability to · She has the ability to solve the problem.（她有能力解决这个问题。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"能力"，联想 able
full_cards.nuance: ability（能力，天生或习得）、capability（潜在能力）；have the ability to do

full_cards.why: 一词多义，阅读/完形常考
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 bēam（树、梁），后指"光柱"
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"必木"→ 一根"木"（beam 是横梁），又像一束光。画面：阳光像横梁一样照进来
full_cards.example: a beam of light · A beam of light shone through the window.（一束光透过窗户照进来。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"一束/横梁/发光"，记 a beam of light
full_cards.nuance: beam（一束光、横梁、微笑发光）、bean（豆子）别混淆

full_cards.why: 身体部位词，与 waste（浪费）同音易混
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 wæst（腰）
full_cards.mnemonic: 同音辨析：waist（腰，中间有 i 像腰带）vs waste（浪费，e 像扔掉的垃圾）。画面：腰带系在"腰"上
full_cards.example: around the waist · The belt is around her waist.（腰带系在她的腰上。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"腰"，区分 waist / waste
full_cards.nuance: waist（腰）、waste（浪费）；同音不同义是听力/拼写考点

full_cards.why: 校园/社会话题高频
full_cards.etymology: act（做）+ -ivity（名词）→ 做的事 → 活动
full_cards.mnemonic: act + ivity → "做"（act）出来的事 → 活动。联想 active（活跃的）
full_cards.example: outdoor activity · Hiking is a popular outdoor activity.（徒步是流行的户外活动。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"活动"，联想 act / active
full_cards.nuance: activity（活动，可数）、action（行动，不可数多）

full_cards.why: 阅读描述"复杂"高频，易与 complex 混淆
full_cards.etymology: com-（一起）+ plic（折叠）+ -ated → 折在一起 → 复杂
full_cards.mnemonic: com + plic（折叠）→ 一张纸"折"来折去 → 复杂。画面：纸折成一团理不清
full_cards.example: a complicated problem · It's a complicated problem to solve.（这是个复杂难解的问题。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"复杂的"，联想 plic=折
full_cards.nuance: complicated（复杂难懂）、complex（复杂，侧重结构）；反义 simple

full_cards.why: 拼写特殊（w 不发音），是拼写题陷阱
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 sweord（剑）
full_cards.mnemonic: sword 里 w 不发音，读作 sord；记 "s + word（词）"→ 一句话像一把"剑"。画面：唇枪舌剑
full_cards.example: a double-edged sword · Technology is a double-edged sword.（科技是把双刃剑。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"剑"，记住 w 不发音
full_cards.nuance: sword 的 w 不发音（/sɔːrd/）；a double-edged sword 双刃剑（引申利弊并存）

full_cards.why: 情感类高频，admire sb for 是搭配
full_cards.etymology: ad-（向）+ mire（惊奇，同 miracle）→ 对…惊叹 → 钦佩
full_cards.mnemonic: ad + mire（=miracle 奇迹）→ 看到"奇迹"心生惊叹 → 钦佩。画面：仰望大神
full_cards.example: admire sb for · I admire her for her courage.（我钦佩她的勇气。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"钦佩"+ 搭配 admire sb for sth
full_cards.nuance: admire sb for（因…钦佩）、admire 后不接从句；名词 admiration

full_cards.why: 语法题常考 phrase 与 clause 区别
full_cards.etymology: 希腊语 phrasis（表达方式）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"弗雷兹"→ 几个词凑成"一句话"，像朋友"弗雷兹"在说 → 短语。画面：几个词手拉手
full_cards.example: a set phrase · "Kick the bucket" is a set phrase.（"kick the bucket" 是个固定短语。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"短语"，区分 phrase / clause
full_cards.nuance: phrase（短语，无主语谓语）、clause（从句，有主语谓语）；set phrase 固定短语

full_cards.why: take advantage of 是超高频短语
full_cards.etymology: avant（在前，同 advance）+ -age → 在前面的位置 → 优势
full_cards.mnemonic: advance（前进）+ tage → 冲在"前面" → 优势。画面：起跑领先一步
full_cards.example: take advantage of · We should take advantage of the chance.（我们应抓住这个机会。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"优势"+ 搭配 take advantage of（利用）
full_cards.nuance: take advantage of（利用，中性/贬义都可）、have an advantage over（胜过）；反义 disadvantage

full_cards.why: aim at / aim to 是写作高频
full_cards.etymology: 古法语 esmer（估计、瞄准）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"诶母"→ "诶"瞄准目标"母"靶心 → 瞄准、目标。画面：拉弓对准靶心
full_cards.example: aim at · The policy aims at reducing pollution.（这项政策旨在减少污染。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"目标/瞄准"+ 搭配 aim at / aim to
full_cards.nuance: aim at + 名词/动名词、aim to + 动词原形；goal（目标）是近义名词

full_cards.why: 单复数同形是考点
full_cards.etymology: air（空中）+ craft（飞行器）→ 飞行器
full_cards.mnemonic: air + craft → 在"空中"（air）的"工艺"（craft）→ 飞机。画面：飞机翱翔
full_cards.example: a commercial aircraft · The aircraft is ready to take off.（飞机准备起飞。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"飞机"，记单复数同形
full_cards.nuance: aircraft 单复数同形（one aircraft / two aircraft）；craft 本身也单复数同形

full_cards.why: in combination with 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: com-（一起）+ bin（二）+ -ation → 两者合在一起 → 结合
full_cards.mnemonic: com + bin（两个）+ ation → "两"个绑"一起" → 结合。画面：两根绳子拧成一股
full_cards.example: in combination with · The drug works in combination with exercise.（这种药配合运动才有效。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"结合"+ 搭配 in combination with
full_cards.nuance: combination（结合）、combine（动词结合）；in combination with（与…结合）

full_cards.why: 观点类话题高频
full_cards.etymology: critic（批评家）+ -ize（动词）→ 批评
full_cards.mnemonic: critic（批评家）+ ize → 批评家做的事 → 批评。画面：点评者挑毛病
full_cards.example: criticize sb for · He was criticized for being late.（他因迟到被批评。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"批评"+ 搭配 criticize sb for
full_cards.nuance: criticize sb for（因…批评）、blame sb for（责怪）；英式拼 criticize/-se 皆可

full_cards.why: 不规则动词 drink 的过去分词作形容词
full_cards.etymology: drink（喝）的过去分词
full_cards.mnemonic: drink（喝）→ drunk（喝多了的）。画面：喝到东倒西歪
full_cards.example: get drunk · He got drunk at the party.（他在聚会上喝醉了。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"醉的"，记 drink-drank-drunk
full_cards.nuance: drunk（醉的，作形容词/名词）、drunken（醉酒的，作定语）；get drunk 喝醉

full_cards.why: be concerned about 是高频搭配
full_cards.etymology: con-（一起）+ cern（筛选）→ 一起分辨 → 关系到
full_cards.mnemonic: con + cern（sift 筛选）→ 事情把你"筛"进来 → 与你有关 → 关心。画面：事情找上门
full_cards.example: be concerned about · Parents are concerned about their children.（父母关心孩子。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"关心/涉及"+ 搭配 be concerned about
full_cards.nuance: be concerned about（担心）、be concerned with（涉及）；concerning（介词，关于）

full_cards.why: be conscious of 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: con-（一起）+ sci（知道，同 science）+ -ous → 一起知道 → 意识到的
full_cards.mnemonic: con + sci（=science 知道）+ ous → 心里"知道"→ 有意识的。画面：清醒地感知到
full_cards.example: be conscious of · He was conscious of his mistake.（他意识到自己的错误。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"意识到的"+ 搭配 be conscious of
full_cards.nuance: be conscious of（意识到）、be aware of（同义，更常用）；反义 unconscious

full_cards.why: 环保/文化话题高频
full_cards.etymology: pre-（预先）+ serve（保护，同 serve）→ 提前保护 → 保存
full_cards.mnemonic: pre（预先）+ serve（保护）→ 提前保护起来 → 保存。画面：提前把食物腌起来防腐
full_cards.example: preserve the environment · We must preserve the environment.（我们必须保护环境。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"保护/保存"+ 搭配 preserve the environment
full_cards.nuance: preserve（保存原状、保护）、reserve（预订、保留）、conserve（节约资源）；三者易混

full_cards.why: arrange to do / arrange for 是搭配考点
full_cards.etymology: a-（到）+ range（排列）→ 排成一列 → 安排
full_cards.mnemonic: a + range（范围、排列）→ 把东西排进"范围"里 → 安排。画面：把书一本本排好
full_cards.example: arrange a meeting · Let's arrange a meeting next week.（我们下周安排个会议吧。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"安排"+ 搭配 arrange to do / arrange for
full_cards.nuance: arrange to do（安排做）、arrange for sb to do（安排某人做）；名词 arrangement

full_cards.why: 一词多义，阅读常考
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 delicatus（令人愉悦的、精致的）
full_cards.mnemonic: de + lic + ate → 精致得像甜点，"吃"（ate）都舍不得 → 精美的、易碎的。画面：捧着一只薄瓷杯
full_cards.example: delicate balance · The body keeps a delicate balance.（身体保持着微妙的平衡。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"易碎的/精美的/微妙的"，记 delicate balance
full_cards.nuance: delicate（易碎、精美、微妙）、fragile（易碎的，侧重脆弱）；delicate balance 微妙平衡

full_cards.why: 娱乐话题高频
full_cards.etymology: enter-（在…之间）+ tain（抓，同 ten-）→ 抓住注意力 → 娱乐
full_cards.mnemonic: enter + tain（=抓）→ 进（enter）门把客人"抓"住、哄开心 → 招待、娱乐。画面：主人热情迎客
full_cards.example: entertain guests · They entertained their guests with music.（他们用音乐招待客人。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"娱乐/招待"，联想 enter + tain
full_cards.nuance: entertain（娱乐、招待）、entertainment（娱乐，名词）；entertaining（有趣的）

full_cards.why: participate in 是超高频短语
full_cards.etymology: part（部分）+ -icipate（拿）→ 拿一份 → 参与
full_cards.mnemonic: part（部分）+ i + cipate → 拿"一部分"（part）→ 参与。画面：分到一份活儿
full_cards.example: participate in · Students should participate in class activities.（学生应参与课堂活动。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"参与"+ 搭配 participate in
full_cards.nuance: participate in（参与，正式）、take part in（参加，口语）；名词 participation

full_cards.why: on arrival 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: arrive（到达）+ -al（名词）→ 到达
full_cards.mnemonic: arrive + al → 到达的名词。画面：列车进站
full_cards.example: on arrival · We'll contact you on arrival.（我们一到就联系你。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"到达"，联想 arrive
full_cards.nuance: on arrival（一到就）、arrival 不可数多；arrive at/in（到达）

full_cards.why: 一词多义，阅读/完形常考
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 brēdan（养育）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"布瑞德"→ 养"布"谷鸟一样繁衍 → 繁殖。画面：一窝小动物
full_cards.example: breed animals · Farmers breed animals for food.（农民饲养动物供食用。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"繁殖/品种"，记 breed 一词多义
full_cards.nuance: breed（繁殖、品种）、raise（饲养）；breed 的过去式 bred

full_cards.why: compete with/against 是高频搭配
full_cards.etymology: com-（一起）+ pete（追求，同 pet-）→ 一起追求 → 竞争
full_cards.mnemonic: com（一起）+ pete（追求）→ 一起"追求"同一目标 → 竞争。画面：赛跑你追我赶
full_cards.example: compete with · We must compete with other companies.（我们必须与其他公司竞争。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"竞争"+ 搭配 compete with/against
full_cards.nuance: compete with/against（与…竞争）、compete for（争夺）；名词 competition、形容词 competitive

full_cards.why: criticize 的名词，观点类高频
full_cards.etymology: critic（批评家）+ -ism（名词）→ 批评
full_cards.mnemonic: criticize（批评）+ ism → 批评的名词。联想前面学的 criticize
full_cards.example: accept criticism · It's hard to accept criticism.（接受批评很难。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"批评"，联想 criticize
full_cards.nuance: criticism（批评，不可数）、comment（评论，中性）；constructive criticism 建设性批评

full_cards.why: 情感话题高频，区分 emotion/feeling 是考点
full_cards.etymology: e-（出）+ mot（动，同 move）+ -ion → 心里涌动出来 → 情感
full_cards.mnemonic: e + motion（动作）→ 情绪让你"动"起来 → 情感。画面：内心波动
full_cards.example: control one's emotion · She couldn't control her emotion.（她无法控制情绪。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"情感"，联想 motion（动）
full_cards.nuance: emotion（强烈情感）、feeling（感受，更宽泛）；emotional（情感的、情绪化的）

full_cards.why: make arrangements for 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: arrange（安排）+ -ment → 安排
full_cards.mnemonic: arrange + ment → 安排的名词。联想前面学的 arrange
full_cards.example: make arrangements · We made arrangements for the trip.（我们为旅行做了安排。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"安排"+ 搭配 make arrangements for
full_cards.nuance: make arrangements for（为…做准备，常用复数）

full_cards.why: commit a crime / be committed to 双考点
full_cards.etymology: com-（一起）+ mit（送，同 miss）→ 一起送出 → 投入、犯
full_cards.mnemonic: com + mit（=送）→ 把自己"送"进去 → 犯（罪）、投入。画面：一失足成千古恨
full_cards.example: commit a crime · He committed a serious crime.（他犯了重罪。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"犯(罪)/承诺"+ 搭配 commit a crime / be committed to
full_cards.nuance: commit a crime（犯罪）、be committed to（致力于）；commit 还有"承诺"义

full_cards.why: advise doing / advise sb to do 是高频考点
full_cards.etymology: ad-（向）+ vise（看，同 vis-）→ 帮人看清 → 建议
full_cards.mnemonic: ad + vise（=vision 看）→ 帮人"看清"方向 → 建议。画面：指路人
full_cards.example: advise sb to do · The doctor advised him to rest.（医生建议他休息。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"建议"+ 搭配 advise sb to do
full_cards.nuance: advise（动词，s 发音 /z/）、advice（名词，c 发音 /s/）；advise sb to do / advise doing

full_cards.why: -ology 学科后缀，可一串记多个
full_cards.etymology: bio（生命）+ -logy（学问）→ 生命科学 → 生物学
full_cards.mnemonic: bio（生命）+ logy（学）→ 研究"生命"的学问 → 生物学。画面：显微镜下的细胞
full_cards.example: study biology · She wants to study biology at college.（她想在大学学生物。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"生物学"，联想 bio=生命、-logy=学
full_cards.nuance: -logy 学科后缀：biology 生物、psychology 心理、geology 地质、technology 技术

full_cards.why: 合成词，p 不发音是拼写/发音陷阱
full_cards.etymology: cup（杯）+ board（板）→ 放杯子的板柜 → 碗柜
full_cards.mnemonic: cup + board → 放"杯子"的"板"柜 → 碗柜。注意 p 不发音（读 /ˈkʌbərd/）
full_cards.example: a kitchen cupboard · The plates are in the cupboard.（盘子在碗柜里。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"碗柜"，记 cup + board、p 不发音
full_cards.nuance: cupboard 的 p 不发音；合成词拆分帮助拼写

full_cards.why: en- 使动前缀，可一串记
full_cards.etymology: en-（使）+ close（关）→ 关进去 → 包围
full_cards.mnemonic: en + close → 使"关"（close）进去 → 包围、封入。画面：把信封进信封
full_cards.example: enclose a photo · I enclose a photo with the letter.（我在信中附上一张照片。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"围住/附上"，联想 en + close
full_cards.nuance: enclose（围住、附上）、enclosure（附件、围场）；en- 使动前缀：enable、enrich

full_cards.why: 经济话题高频，与 industry 同根
full_cards.etymology: industry（工业）+ -al（形容词）→ 工业的
full_cards.mnemonic: industry + al → 工业的。画面：工厂烟囱
full_cards.example: industrial development · Industrial development is rapid here.（这里的工业发展很快。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"工业的"，联想 industry
full_cards.nuance: industrial（工业的）、industrious（勤奋的，易混淆）；industry 工业/勤奋

full_cards.why: 社会话题高频，与 politics 同根
full_cards.etymology: polit（城市，同 policy）+ -ical → 治理城市 → 政治的
full_cards.mnemonic: policy（政策）+ tical → 跟"政策"有关 → 政治的。画面：议会大厅
full_cards.example: political issue · This is a sensitive political issue.（这是个敏感的政治议题。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"政治的"，联想 policy
full_cards.nuance: political（政治的）、politics（政治，学科）、politician（政客）；police 也同源（治理城邦）

full_cards.why: refuse 的名词，拼写变化是考点
full_cards.etymology: refuse（拒绝）+ -al（名词）→ 拒绝
full_cards.mnemonic: refuse + al → 拒绝的名词（注意 refuse 结尾 e 去掉）。画面：摇头摆手
full_cards.example: a flat refusal · He gave a flat refusal.（他断然拒绝。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"拒绝"，联想 refuse → refusal
full_cards.nuance: refuse（动词拒绝）、refusal（名词拒绝）、reject（拒绝，更强烈）；a flat refusal 断然拒绝

full_cards.why: 商业话题高频
full_cards.etymology: ad-（向）+ vert（转，同 vers-）+ -ise → 把注意力转过来 → 广告
full_cards.mnemonic: ad + vert（转）+ ise → 让路人把注意力"转"过来 → 打广告。画面：霓虹灯吸引眼球
full_cards.example: advertise a product · They advertise their products on TV.（他们在电视上给产品做广告。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"做广告"，联想 vert=转
full_cards.nuance: advertise（动词）、advertisement（名词，广告）；advertise for（登广告招聘）

full_cards.why: 自然话题词，beat around the bush 是习语
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 busc（灌木）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"布什"→ 美国总统布什名字就念 bush → 灌木丛（名字联想）。画面：一丛矮树
full_cards.example: beat around the bush · Stop beating around the bush.（别再拐弯抹角了。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"灌木"，记 beat around the bush（拐弯抹角）
full_cards.nuance: beat around the bush（说话绕弯子，习语）

full_cards.why: take action 是高频短语
full_cards.etymology: act（做）+ -ion → 行为、行动
full_cards.mnemonic: act + ion → "做"（act）的名词 → 行动。画面：说干就干
full_cards.example: take action · We must take action to stop pollution.（我们必须采取行动阻止污染。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"行动"+ 搭配 take action
full_cards.nuance: take action（采取行动，不可数）、actions（行为，可数复数）；action 与 activity 区别

full_cards.why: 时序连接词，阅读常考
full_cards.etymology: after（之后）+ -ward（方向）→ 往后 → 后来
full_cards.mnemonic: after + ward（=向）→ 朝"之后"的方向 → 后来。画面：时间轴往后
full_cards.example: soon afterward · Soon afterward, he left the city.（不久之后，他离开了城市。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"后来"，联想 after + ward
full_cards.nuance: afterward（美）、afterwards（英）同义；beforehand（事先）是其反方向

full_cards.why: 情感话题高频，拼写双 r 双 s 是陷阱
full_cards.etymology: em-（使）+ barrass（阻碍）→ 使人卡住 → 窘迫
full_cards.mnemonic: 拼写记忆：em + bar（酒吧）+ r + ass → 在酒吧里出丑 → 尴尬。画面：当众出糗
full_cards.example: embarrass sb · His question embarrassed me.（他的问题让我很尴尬。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"使尴尬"，记双 r 双 s（embarrass）
full_cards.nuance: embarrass（及物，使尴尬）、be embarrassed（感到尴尬）、embarrassing（令人尴尬的）

full_cards.why: -ing/-ed 形容词辨析是考点
full_cards.etymology: amuse（逗乐）+ -ing → 令人发笑的
full_cards.mnemonic: amuse + ing → 让人"发笑"的 → 有趣的。画面：看喜剧哈哈大笑
full_cards.example: an amusing story · He told an amusing story.（他讲了个有趣的故事。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"有趣的"，区分 amusing / amused
full_cards.nuance: amusing（令人发笑，修饰事物）、amused（感到好笑，修饰人）；同根 amuse

full_cards.why: 拟声词，形象易记
full_cards.etymology: 拟声词，模仿气泡破裂声
full_cards.mnemonic: 拟声：bubble 读起来像"卜卜"冒泡声。画面：水开冒泡
full_cards.example: soap bubble · The children blew soap bubbles.（孩子们吹肥皂泡。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"气泡"，记拟声"卜卜"
full_cards.nuance: bubble（气泡）、bubble economy（泡沫经济，引申）

full_cards.why: amuse oneself 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: a-（向）+ muse（沉思）→ 让人放松不想事 → 娱乐
full_cards.mnemonic: a + muse（=music 音乐）→ 用"音乐"逗人开心 → 逗乐。画面：弹琴唱歌让人笑
full_cards.example: amuse oneself · The kids amused themselves with toys.（孩子们玩玩具自娱自乐。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"逗乐"，联想 muse/music
full_cards.nuance: amuse oneself（自娱自乐）、amuse sb with（用…逗乐）；派生 amusing/amused

full_cards.why: the authorities 是新闻高频
full_cards.etymology: author（创始人）+ -ity → 创始人地位 → 权威
full_cards.mnemonic: author（作者）+ ity → 作者最懂自己的书 → 权威。画面：专家发言
full_cards.example: the authorities · The authorities are investigating the case.（当局正在调查此案。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"权威/当局"，联想 author
full_cards.nuance: authority（权威，不可数）、the authorities（当局，复数）；authorize（授权）

full_cards.why: there is a possibility that 是句型
full_cards.etymology: possible（可能的）+ -ity → 可能性
full_cards.mnemonic: possible + ity → 可能的（possible）名词 → 可能性
full_cards.example: the possibility of · There is a possibility of rain.（有可能下雨。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"可能性"，联想 possible
full_cards.nuance: possibility（可能性）、probability（概率，更确定）；there is a possibility of/that

full_cards.why: -th 名词后缀，可一串记（length/depth）
full_cards.etymology: wide（宽）+ -th（名词）→ 宽度
full_cards.mnemonic: wide + th → 宽（wide）的名词 → 宽度。画面：量尺横着量
full_cards.example: in width · The room is 5 meters in width.（这个房间宽 5 米。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"宽度"，联想 wide；记 -th 后缀
full_cards.nuance: -th 名词：width 宽、length 长、depth 深、strength 强；wide（形）→ width（名）

full_cards.why: 心理健康话题高频
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 anxius（焦虑的）→ anxiety
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"俺在爱特"→ "俺"因为太"爱"所以"特"别焦虑 → 焦虑。画面：坐立不安
full_cards.example: anxiety about · She felt anxiety about the exam.（她对考试感到焦虑。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"焦虑"，联想 anxious
full_cards.nuance: anxiety（名词焦虑）、anxious（形容词焦虑的）；anxiety about/over（对…焦虑）

full_cards.why: argue 的名词，观点类高频
full_cards.etymology: argue（争论）+ -ment → 争论
full_cards.mnemonic: argue + ment → 争论的名词（注意 argue 去 e）。画面：两人面红耳赤
full_cards.example: a strong argument · He gave a strong argument for the plan.（他为这个计划提出了有力论据。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"争论/论点"，联想 argue
full_cards.nuance: argument（争论、论点）、argue with sb（与…争论）；注意 argue→argument 拼写去 e

full_cards.why: 口语/写作高频副词
full_cards.etymology: actual（实际的）+ -ly → 实际上
full_cards.mnemonic: actual + ly → 实际的（actual）副词 → 实际上。画面：戳破表面看真相
full_cards.example: in fact · Actually, I don't agree with you.（实际上，我不同意你的看法。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"实际上"，联想 actual
full_cards.nuance: actually（实际上，表转折或纠正）、in fact（事实上）；都用于引出真实情况

full_cards.why: approve 的名词，with approval 是搭配
full_cards.etymology: approve（赞成）+ -al → 赞成
full_cards.mnemonic: approve + al → 赞成（approve）的名词。画面：领导盖章通过
full_cards.example: with approval · The plan met with general approval.（这个计划得到普遍赞同。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"赞成/批准"，联想 approve
full_cards.nuance: approve（动词）、approval（名词）、disapproval（反对）；meet with approval 获得赞成

full_cards.why: 写作引出话题的介词，与 about 同义
full_cards.etymology: concern（涉及）+ -ing → 涉及的 → 关于
full_cards.mnemonic: concern（涉及）+ ing → 涉及到的 → 关于。画面：话题范围圈定
full_cards.example: concerning the matter · I have nothing to say concerning the matter.（关于此事我无可奉告。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"关于"，联想 concern
full_cards.nuance: concerning（介词，关于，正式）= regarding；不要与 concern 动词混淆

full_cards.why: 一词多义，阅读常考
full_cards.etymology: de-（完全）+ liber（称量，同 libra 天平）+ -ate → 反复掂量 → 深思熟虑的、故意的
full_cards.mnemonic: de + liber（=liberty 自由）+ ate → 想清楚了才"自由"行动 → 从容的、蓄意的。画面：慢慢盘算再出手
full_cards.example: a deliberate act · It was a deliberate act, not an accident.（这是蓄意行为，不是意外。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"故意的/从容的"，记 deliberate 双义
full_cards.nuance: deliberate（故意的、从容的）、deliberately（故意地，副词）；反义 accidental

full_cards.why: -ing/-ed 辨析，与 embarrass 同根
full_cards.etymology: embarrass（使尴尬）+ -ing → 令人尴尬的
full_cards.mnemonic: embarrass + ing → 让人"尴尬"的 → 令人尴尬的。画面：当众出丑
full_cards.example: an embarrassing moment · It was an embarrassing moment for me.（那是我尴尬的一刻。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"令人尴尬的"，区分 embarrassing / embarrassed
full_cards.nuance: embarrassing（令人尴尬，修饰事）、embarrassed（感到尴尬，修饰人）

full_cards.why: 拼写与 bulletin（公告）易混
full_cards.etymology: 法语 boulette（小球）→ 子弹
full_cards.mnemonic: bull（公牛）+ et → 像公牛冲撞一样有力 → 子弹。画面：子弹呼啸而出
full_cards.example: a bullet · The bullet hit the target.（子弹击中目标。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"子弹"，联想 bull（公牛）
full_cards.nuance: bullet（子弹）、bulletin（公告，多一个 in）；bullet train 高铁

full_cards.why: 冲突话题高频，与 crash/crush 易混
full_cards.etymology: 拟声词，模仿碰撞声
full_cards.mnemonic: 拟声：clash 像"咔啦"碰撞声。画面：两车相撞、意见冲突
full_cards.example: clash with · His view clashes with mine.（他的观点与我的冲突。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"冲突"+ 搭配 clash with
full_cards.nuance: clash（意见冲突、金属碰撞声）、crash（撞毁）、crush（压碎）；三词易混

full_cards.why: approve of 是高频搭配
full_cards.etymology: ap-（向）+ prove（证明）→ 证明是对的 → 赞成
full_cards.mnemonic: ap + prove（证明）→ 被"证明"靠谱 → 赞成、批准。画面：审查通过盖章
full_cards.example: approve of · I don't approve of his plan.（我不赞成他的计划。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"赞成/批准"+ 搭配 approve of
full_cards.nuance: approve of（赞成）、approve（批准，正式）；名词 approval

full_cards.why: 口语高频，拼写易错（definite + ly）
full_cards.etymology: definite（明确的）+ -ly → 明确地
full_cards.mnemonic: definite + ly → 明确（definite）的副词。画面：斩钉截铁
full_cards.example: definitely · It will definitely rain tomorrow.（明天一定会下雨。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"一定"，记 definite + ly（不是 definately）
full_cards.nuance: definitely（一定、明确）、certainly（当然）；拼写：definite 是 finite（有限）加 de

full_cards.meaning: 合乎需要的，令人满意的
full_cards.why: desire 派生，-able 后缀
full_cards.etymology: desire（渴望）+ -able → 值得渴望的 → 合意的
full_cards.mnemonic: desire + able → 让人"渴望"（desire）的 → 合意的。画面：梦寐以求
full_cards.example: a desirable result · Getting a high score is a desirable result.（得高分是理想的结果。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"合意的"，联想 desire
full_cards.nuance: desirable（合意的，修饰物）、desirous（渴望的，修饰人）；desire（渴望）

full_cards.why: determine 的名词，意志类话题高频
full_cards.etymology: determine（决定）+ -ation → 决心
full_cards.mnemonic: determine + ation → 决定（determine）的名词。画面：握拳下定决心
full_cards.example: with determination · She worked with great determination.（她以极大的决心工作。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"决心"，联想 determine
full_cards.nuance: determination（决心，不可数）、decision（决定，具体）；determine to do（决心做）

full_cards.why: grace + -ful 构词清晰
full_cards.etymology: grace（优雅）+ -ful → 优美的
full_cards.mnemonic: grace + ful → 充满"优雅"（grace）→ 优美的。画面：芭蕾舞者
full_cards.example: a graceful dancer · She is a graceful dancer.（她是位优雅的舞者。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"优美的"，联想 grace
full_cards.nuance: graceful（优美的）、gracious（和蔼的）；grace（优雅、恩惠）

full_cards.why: impress 派生，评价类高频
full_cards.etymology: impress（留下印象）+ -ive → 印象深刻的
full_cards.mnemonic: impress + ive → 让人"印象深刻"（impress）的 → 感人的。画面：叹为观止
full_cards.example: an impressive performance · It was an impressive performance.（那是场令人印象深刻的演出。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"印象深刻的"，联想 impress
full_cards.nuance: impressive（令人印象深刻的）、impressed（感到印象深刻的）；impress sb with

full_cards.why: 拼写与 through（穿过）易混，是高频陷阱
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 þurh（穿过），与 through 同源
full_cards.mnemonic: 拼写对比：through（穿过，有 r + ough）vs thorough（彻底，多个 o）。记：查得"彻彻底底"多一个 o
full_cards.example: a thorough check · We made a thorough check of the house.（我们彻底检查了房子。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"彻底的"，区分 thorough / through
full_cards.nuance: thorough（彻底 /ˈθɜːroʊ/）、through（穿过 /θruː/）；发音和拼写都不同

full_cards.why: be ashamed of 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: a-（加强）+ shame（羞耻）+ -ed → 感到羞耻的
full_cards.mnemonic: a + shame（羞耻）+ d → 心里"羞耻" → 惭愧。画面：低头脸红
full_cards.example: be ashamed of · He is ashamed of his mistake.（他为自己的错误感到羞愧。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"惭愧的"+ 搭配 be ashamed of
full_cards.nuance: be ashamed of（为…羞愧）、shameful（可耻的，修饰事）；区分 ashamed/shameful

full_cards.why: 数据变化类高频，与 increase 对比
full_cards.etymology: de-（向下）+ crease（增长，同 create）→ 向下增长 → 减少
full_cards.mnemonic: de（向下）+ crease（=increase 增长）→ "向下增长"→ 减少。对比 increase（增加）
full_cards.example: decrease by · The number decreased by 10%.（数字下降了 10%。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"减少"，对比 increase
full_cards.nuance: decrease（减少，动词/名词）、reduce（减少，及物）；decrease by（减少了）、decrease to（减少到）

full_cards.why: excited/exciting 辨析是超高频考点
full_cards.etymology: ex-（出）+ cite（唤起，同 cit-）→ 唤起出来 → 激发
full_cards.mnemonic: ex + cite（=cit 唤起）→ 把情绪"唤起"来 → 使兴奋。画面：一触即发
full_cards.example: excite interest · The news excited great interest.（这消息激起了极大兴趣。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"使兴奋"，区分 excited / exciting
full_cards.nuance: excite（动词）、excited（感到兴奋）、exciting（令人兴奋）；-ed 修饰人、-ing 修饰物

full_cards.why: in honor of 是固定短语
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 honor（荣誉）
full_cards.mnemonic: honor（荣誉，英式 honour 多一个 u）→ 谐音"奥诺"像颁奖时的庄重。画面：领奖台
full_cards.example: in honor of · The dinner was held in honor of the guests.（晚宴为款待客人而举行。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"荣誉/尊敬"+ 搭配 in honor of
full_cards.nuance: in honor of（为纪念/向…致敬）、honor（美）/honour（英）；honorable（光荣的）

full_cards.why: advertise 的名词，商业话题高频
full_cards.etymology: advertise（做广告）+ -ment → 广告
full_cards.mnemonic: advertise + ment → 广告。联想前面学的 advertise。画面：广告牌
full_cards.example: a TV advertisement · I saw a TV advertisement for the phone.（我看到这款手机的电视广告。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"广告"，联想 advertise
full_cards.nuance: advertisement（正式）、ad（口语缩写）；advertise for（登广告）

full_cards.why: deserve to do 是高频句型
full_cards.etymology: de-（完全）+ serve（服务）→ 服务到位应得的 → 应受
full_cards.mnemonic: de + serve（服务）→ 干得好、服务到位 → "值得"奖赏。画面：劳有所得
full_cards.example: deserve to · You deserve to win the prize.（你理应获奖。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"值得/应受"+ 搭配 deserve to do
full_cards.nuance: deserve to do（理应做）、deserve + 名词（应受）；deserve 后不接 for

full_cards.why: affect/effect 辨析是超高频考点
full_cards.etymology: af-（向）+ fect（做，同 fac-）→ 对…起作用 → 影响
full_cards.mnemonic: A 联想 action（动词）→ affect 作"动词"；E 联想 end result（结果）→ effect 作"名词"。画面：一石激起千层浪
full_cards.example: affect sb · The noise affects my sleep.（噪音影响我的睡眠。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"影响"，区分 affect（动词）/ effect（名词）
full_cards.nuance: affect（动词，影响）、effect（名词，影响/结果）；have an effect on = affect

full_cards.why: 科技话题词
full_cards.etymology: a-（不）+ tom（切）→ 不可再切的 → 原子
full_cards.mnemonic: a（不）+ tom（切）→ "切不开"的最小粒子 → 原子。画面：最小的微粒
full_cards.example: an atom · Water is made of atoms.（水由原子组成。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"原子"，联想 a-（不）+ tom（切）
full_cards.nuance: atom（原子）、atomic（原子的）；a- 否定 + tom 切割 = 不可分割

full_cards.why: attach importance to 是高频短语
full_cards.etymology: a-（向）+ tach（钉，同 tack）→ 钉上去 → 附上
full_cards.mnemonic: a + tach（=tack 图钉）→ 用"图钉"钉上去 → 附上。画面：把便签钉在板上
full_cards.example: attach importance to · We attach great importance to education.（我们高度重视教育。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"附上"+ 搭配 attach importance to
full_cards.nuance: attach importance to（重视）、be attached to（依恋、附属）；attachment（附件）

full_cards.why: 一词多义，阅读/完形常考
full_cards.etymology: awk（反向，古诺斯语）+ -ward → 转向错误方向 → 笨拙
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"奥克沃德"→ 手脚不协调"噢"地撞到 → 笨拙、尴尬。画面：同手同脚
full_cards.example: an awkward situation · It was an awkward situation.（那是个尴尬的局面。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"笨拙的/尴尬的"，记 awkward 双义
full_cards.nuance: awkward（笨拙、尴尬）、clumsy（笨拙，侧重动作）；an awkward question 棘手的问题

full_cards.why: definitely 的原形，拼写考点
full_cards.etymology: de-（加强）+ finite（有限）→ 划清界限 → 明确
full_cards.mnemonic: de + finite（有限）→ 把范围"限"清楚 → 明确。画面：划出清晰边界
full_cards.example: a definite answer · I need a definite answer.（我需要一个明确的答复。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"明确的"，联想 finite（有限）
full_cards.nuance: definite（明确的）、definitely（明确地）、infinite（无限的）；de + finite 限

full_cards.why: be independent of 是高频搭配
full_cards.etymology: in-（不）+ dependent（依赖的）→ 不依赖的 → 独立
full_cards.mnemonic: in（不）+ dependent（依赖）→ "不依赖"别人 → 独立。画面：自己站立
full_cards.example: be independent of · Children should learn to be independent of parents.（孩子应学会独立于父母。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"独立的"+ 搭配 be independent of
full_cards.nuance: be independent of（独立于）、depend on（依赖）；名词 independence（独立）

full_cards.why: actual/actually 高频，与 current 区分
full_cards.etymology: act（做）+ -ual → 做出来的 → 实际的
full_cards.mnemonic: act + ual → 真正"做"出来的 → 实际的。画面：眼见为实
full_cards.example: the actual cost · The actual cost is higher than expected.（实际成本比预期高。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"实际的"，联想 act
full_cards.nuance: actual（实际的，与想象相对）、current（当前的）；actual ≠ 当前的

full_cards.why: behave well / behave oneself 是搭配
full_cards.etymology: be-（使）+ have（拥有）→ 把持自己 → 举止
full_cards.mnemonic: be + have → 把自己"拥有"好、管住 → 举止。画面：规规矩矩
full_cards.example: behave well · The children behaved well in class.（孩子们课堂上表现很好。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"举止"+ 搭配 behave well / behave oneself
full_cards.nuance: behave（举止）、behavior（行为，名词）；behave oneself（守规矩）

full_cards.why: deceive sb into 是高频搭配
full_cards.etymology: de-（向下）+ ceive（拿，同 capt-）→ 把人骗到手 → 欺骗
full_cards.mnemonic: de + ceive（=receive 拿）→ 用花招"拿"走你的信任 → 欺骗。画面：谎言骗走信任
full_cards.example: deceive sb into · He deceived us into believing him.（他骗我们相信他。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"欺骗"，联想 receive（ceive=拿）
full_cards.nuance: deceive sb into doing（骗某人做）、cheat（作弊/欺骗）；名词 deception

full_cards.why: fortune + -ate，构词清晰
full_cards.etymology: fortune（运气）+ -ate → 有好运的 → 幸运
full_cards.mnemonic: fortune + ate → 有好"运气"（fortune）的 → 幸运。画面：中彩票
full_cards.example: be fortunate to · I was fortunate to pass the exam.（我很幸运通过了考试。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"幸运的"，联想 fortune
full_cards.nuance: fortunate（幸运的）、fortunately（幸运地）、unfortunately（不幸地）；反义 unlucky

full_cards.why: be related to 是高频短语
full_cards.etymology: relate（关联）+ -ed → 相关的
full_cards.mnemonic: relate + ed → 有关联（relate）的 → 相关的。画面：一根线连着两头
full_cards.example: be related to · Health is related to diet.（健康与饮食有关。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"相关的"+ 搭配 be related to
full_cards.nuance: be related to（与…相关）、relative（相对的、亲戚）；relate to（涉及）

full_cards.why: in advance 是超高频短语
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 abante（向前）→ 前进
full_cards.mnemonic: ad + vance（=vant 前）→ 朝"前" → 前进。画面：冲锋向前
full_cards.example: in advance · Please book the tickets in advance.（请提前订票。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"前进/提前"+ 搭配 in advance
full_cards.nuance: in advance（提前）、advance（前进、提升）、advanced（先进的）；反义 retreat

full_cards.why: 情感话题高频，be annoyed with 是搭配
full_cards.etymology: 古法语 anoier（烦扰）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"安闹"→ 心里"闹"得不安 → 烦恼。画面：蚊子嗡嗡烦人
full_cards.example: annoy sb · The noise annoyed me.（噪音让我很烦。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"使烦恼"+ 搭配 be annoyed with
full_cards.nuance: be annoyed with（对人生气）、be annoyed at（对事生气）；annoying（烦人的）

full_cards.why: be anxious about / anxious to 双搭配
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 anxius（焦虑的）
full_cards.mnemonic: anx（=anxiety 焦虑）+ ious → 焦虑的。联想 anxiety。画面：眉头紧锁
full_cards.example: be anxious about · She is anxious about her health.（她担心自己的健康。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"焦虑的/渴望的"+ 搭配 be anxious about
full_cards.nuance: be anxious about（担心）、be anxious to do（渴望做）；名词 anxiety

full_cards.why: describe 的名词，拼写变化是考点
full_cards.etymology: describe（描写）+ -tion → 描写
full_cards.mnemonic: describe + tion → 描写（describe）的名词。画面：用文字画像
full_cards.example: a detailed description · He gave a detailed description of the man.（他详细描述了那个人。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"描写"，联想 describe → description
full_cards.nuance: describe（动词）→ description（名词，注意 e→p）；describe sth as（把…描述为）

full_cards.why: 口语高频，与 terrible/terrific 区分
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 terribilis（可怕的），与 terror 同源
full_cards.mnemonic: terr（=terror 恐怖）+ ible → 恐怖的 → 可怕的。画面：吓得发抖
full_cards.example: terrible weather · The weather was terrible yesterday.（昨天天气很糟糕。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"可怕的/糟糕的"，联想 terror
full_cards.nuance: terrible（可怕的、糟糕的）、terrific（极好的，反义！）；terrified（感到恐惧的）

full_cards.why: admit doing / admit to 是高频考点
full_cards.etymology: ad-（向）+ mit（送，同 miss）→ 送进去 → 准入、承认
full_cards.mnemonic: ad + mit（=送）→ 把话"送"出来 → 承认；把门"送"开 → 准入。画面：坦白
full_cards.example: admit doing · He admitted making a mistake.（他承认犯了错。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"承认/准入"+ 搭配 admit doing / admit to
full_cards.nuance: admit doing / admit to doing（承认做）、be admitted to（被录取/准入）；admission（准入）

full_cards.why: foreign affairs 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: 法语 à faire（去做的事）→ 事务
full_cards.mnemonic: af + fair（公平）→ 处理"公平"的事 → 事务。画面：处理公务
full_cards.example: foreign affairs · He works in foreign affairs.（他从事外交工作。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"事务"+ 搭配 foreign affairs（外交事务）
full_cards.nuance: affair（事务、事件，常用复数 affairs）、matter（事情）；foreign affairs 外交

full_cards.why: 灾难/社会话题高频，take shelter 是搭配
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 sceld（盾）+ truma（队伍）→ 盾牌掩护 → 庇护
full_cards.mnemonic: shel（=shell 壳）+ ter → 像"壳"（shell）一样护住 → 庇护。画面：躲进避风港
full_cards.example: take shelter · They took shelter from the storm.（他们躲避暴风雨。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"避难处/庇护"+ 搭配 take shelter
full_cards.nuance: take shelter（躲避）、shelter sb（庇护某人）；shelter 作名词不可数多

full_cards.why: shock + -ing，评价类高频
full_cards.etymology: shock（震惊）+ -ing → 令人震惊的
full_cards.mnemonic: shock + ing → 让人"震惊"（shock）的 → 令人震惊的。画面：目瞪口呆
full_cards.example: shocking news · The news was shocking to everyone.（这消息令所有人震惊。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"令人震惊的"，联想 shock
full_cards.nuance: shocking（令人震惊）、shocked（感到震惊）；-ed 修饰人、-ing 修饰物

full_cards.why: from a different angle 是高频表达
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 angulus（角）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"俺狗"→ 狗看问题有狗的角度 → 角度。画面：换个角度看
full_cards.example: from a different angle · Let's look at it from a different angle.（我们换个角度看问题。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"角度/观点"，区分 angle / angel（天使）
full_cards.nuance: angle（角度）、angel（天使，a-n-g-e-l）；from the angle of（从…角度）

full_cards.why: in comparison with 是固定搭配
full_cards.etymology: compare（比较）+ -ison → 比较
full_cards.mnemonic: compare + ison → 比较（compare）的名词。画面：并排对比
full_cards.example: in comparison with · In comparison with last year, sales rose.（与去年相比，销量上升了。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"比较"+ 搭配 in comparison with
full_cards.nuance: in comparison with（与…相比）、compare A with B（比较）；comparison 名词

full_cards.why: injure 的名词，健康话题高频
full_cards.etymology: in-（不）+ jury（法，同 law）→ 不合法地伤害 → 伤害
full_cards.mnemonic: in + jury（=jury 陪审团）→ 受伤了得上"陪审团"（jury）讨公道 → 伤害。画面：工伤
full_cards.example: a serious injury · He suffered a serious injury in the accident.（他在事故中受了重伤。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"伤害"，联想 injure
full_cards.nuance: injure（动词）→ injury（名词）；injury 是事故伤害，wound 是刀枪伤，hurt 是泛指

full_cards.why: a variety of 是超高频短语
full_cards.etymology: vary（变化）+ -ety → 变化多 → 多样
full_cards.mnemonic: vary（变化）+ ety → 变来变去 → 多样。画面：琳琅满目
full_cards.example: a variety of · The shop sells a variety of goods.（这家店卖各种各样的商品。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"多样/种类"+ 搭配 a variety of
full_cards.nuance: a variety of（各种各样的，接复数名词）、various（形容词，各种各样的）；vary（变化）

full_cards.why: injury 的动词，健康话题高频
full_cards.etymology: in-（不）+ jure（法，同 law）→ 不合法地伤害 → 伤害
full_cards.mnemonic: in + jure → 违"法"（jure）伤人 → 伤害。画面：事故受伤
full_cards.example: injure oneself · He injured himself playing football.（他踢球时弄伤了自己。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"伤害"，联想 injury
full_cards.nuance: injure（事故伤害）、wound（刀枪伤）、hurt（泛指/情感伤）；injured（受伤的）

full_cards.why: 文化话题高频
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 religio（敬畏神）
full_cards.mnemonic: re + lig（=lig 绑）+ ion → 把人和神"绑"在一起 → 宗教。画面：信仰纽带
full_cards.example: freedom of religion · Everyone has the right to freedom of religion.（人人有宗教信仰自由。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"宗教"，联想 lig=绑
full_cards.nuance: religion（宗教）、religious（宗教的）；freedom of religion 信仰自由

full_cards.why: 语法术语（单数），与 single 同源
full_cards.etymology: single（单一）+ -ar → 单一的
full_cards.mnemonic: single + ar → 单一（single）的 → 单数、单一的。画面：形单影只
full_cards.example: singular form · "Child" is the singular form of "children".（child 是 children 的单数形式。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"单一的/单数"，联想 single
full_cards.nuance: singular（单数、单一）、plural（复数）；反义 plural

full_cards.why: 拼写不规律（复数 thieves），是考点
full_cards.etymology: 古英语 þeof（贼）
full_cards.mnemonic: 谐音"西服"→ 偷了别人"西服"的贼 → 小偷。画面：鬼鬼祟祟
full_cards.example: a thief · The police caught the thief.（警察抓住了小偷。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"贼"，记复数 thieves
full_cards.nuance: thief（小偷）→ 复数 thieves（f→v+es）；steal（动词偷）、robbery（抢劫）

full_cards.why: lose one's temper 是高频短语
full_cards.etymology: 拉丁 temperare（调和），与 temperature 同源
full_cards.mnemonic: temper（=temperature 温度）→ 情绪像"温度"一样升降 → 脾气。画面：火冒三丈
full_cards.example: lose one's temper · He lost his temper at the meeting.（他在会上发了脾气。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"脾气"+ 搭配 lose one's temper
full_cards.nuance: lose one's temper（发脾气）、in a good/bad temper（情绪好/坏）；与 temperature 同源

full_cards.why: 学位英语写作高频：enhance efficiency
full_cards.etymology: en-（使）+ hance（抬高，与 high 同源）→ 使变高 → 提高
full_cards.mnemonic: en（使）+ hance（谐音"汉子"）→ 让你变硬汉、更强 → 增强（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: enhance efficiency · Technology can enhance work efficiency.（科技能提高工作效率。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"提高、增强"+ 搭配 enhance efficiency
full_cards.nuance: enhance 提升质量/价值，increase 增加数量；enhance efficiency 比 increase efficiency 更准

full_cards.why: 描述影响/数据高频
full_cards.etymology: sign（标记）+ -ific（做）+ -ant → 值得打标记的 → 显著的
full_cards.mnemonic: sign（签名）+ ant（蚂蚁）→ 一只会签名的蚂蚁，太稀罕 → 重要（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: have a significant impact on · The policy has a significant impact on education.（这项政策对教育有重大影响。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"重要的"+ 搭配 a significant impact on
full_cards.nuance: significant 强调"显著、可观测"，important 泛指重要；同根 significance、significantly

full_cards.why: 阅读观点题、写作表态高频
full_cards.etymology: per-（贯穿）+ spect（看）+ -ive → 看的方式 → 视角
full_cards.mnemonic: per（每个人）+ spect（看）→ 每个人看的角度不一样 → 视角（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: from a different perspective · We should look at the issue from a different perspective.（我们应从不同视角看待这个问题。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"视角/观点"+ 搭配 from a... perspective
full_cards.nuance: perspective 是视角/观点，prospect 才是前景；spect 同根 inspect、spectator、respect

full_cards.why: 阅读结论句、写作结尾高频
full_cards.etymology: con-（一起）+ clude（关，拉丁 claudere）→ 把讨论关起来 → 下结论
full_cards.mnemonic: con（开会）+ clude（谐音"咯噔"关上）→ 会开完合上本子拍板结论（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: conclude that... · The study concludes that exercise improves sleep.（研究得出结论：运动改善睡眠。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"得出结论"+ 搭配 conclude that
full_cards.nuance: conclude ≠ include；-clude 同根 include/exclude；conclusion n. 结论

full_cards.why: 学术阅读/写作高频动词
full_cards.etymology: ana-（分开）+ -lysis（松开）→ analysis → -yze 动词化
full_cards.mnemonic: a（一个）+ na + lyze（谐音"粒子"）→ 把一个东西拆成粒子来看 = 分析（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: analyze the data · We need to analyze the data before deciding.（做决定前需要先分析数据。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"分析"+ 搭配 analyze the data
full_cards.nuance: 美式 analyze / 英式 analyse；同根 analysis n.、analyst n.

full_cards.why: 阅读/写作"评价"语境高频
full_cards.etymology: value（价值，真实词根）+ -ate → 估出价值 → 评估
full_cards.mnemonic: e + value（价值）+ ate（吃）→ 老师把答卷吃下去数"值几个钱" → 评估（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: evaluate the effect · The teacher will evaluate your progress.（老师会评估你的进步。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"评估"+ 搭配 evaluate the effect
full_cards.nuance: 及物动词，后接宾语不加介词 on；同根 evaluation n.

full_cards.why: benefit from 是超高频搭配
full_cards.etymology: bene（好，拉丁）+ fac/fit（做）→ 做得好 → 益处
full_cards.mnemonic: be（使）+ fit（合适、健壮）→ 让你身心合适健壮就是好处 = benefit（人为联想，非词源）
full_cards.example: benefit from · Local residents benefit from the new policy.（当地居民从新政策中受益。）
full_cards.recall: 遮住中文说"益处/受益"+ 搭配 benefit from
full_cards.nuance: benefit from（人受益）vs. benefit sb.（使受益）；同根 beneficial adj.

light_cards.meaning: ad.向后，后退；回复 n.背，背面，后面 a.后面的，背后的 vt.使后退；支持
light_cards.hint: 基础词：背/后面/向后。词组 go back 回去、come back 回来、back up 支持
light_cards.example: Please go back to your seat.（请回到你的座位。）

light_cards.hint: back（后）+ ground（地面）→ 后面的地面 → 背景
light_cards.example: The mountains form a beautiful background.（群山构成美丽的背景。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.使平衡 n.平衡；差额，结余；天平，秤
light_cards.hint: ba（天平两盘）+ lance → 天平两头一样 → 平衡。词组 keep balance 保持平衡
light_cards.example: You should keep a balance between work and rest.（你应该劳逸结合。）

light_cards.hint: 具体名词：鸟嘴。联想 peak（山峰）— 鸟嘴像尖尖的山峰
light_cards.example: The bird has a long beak.（这只鸟长着长长的喙。）

light_cards.hint: 具体名词：照相机。联想 photo camera 相机，camera 里的 cam 像镜头
light_cards.example: She took a photo with her camera.（她用相机拍了张照片。）

light_cards.hint: 具体名词：卡片。词组 ID card 身份证、credit card 信用卡
light_cards.example: He showed his ID card at the door.（他在门口出示了身份证。）

light_cards.meaning: n.注意，小心；挂念；照顾，照料 vi.关心，计较；喜欢，愿意
light_cards.hint: 基础词：关心/照顾。词组 take care of 照顾、care about 关心
light_cards.example: She takes care of her little brother.（她照顾弟弟。）

light_cards.hint: care（小心）+ -less（无）→ 不小心的 → 粗心
light_cards.example: He made a careless mistake.（他犯了个粗心的错误。）

light_cards.hint: 具体动词：跳舞。联想 dancer 舞者
light_cards.example: They danced happily at the party.（他们在聚会上开心地跳舞。）

light_cards.hint: 危险。词组 in danger 处于危险中、out of danger 脱离危险
light_cards.example: The climbers were in great danger.（登山者处于极大的危险中。）

light_cards.hint: danger（危险）+ -ous（形容词）→ 危险的
light_cards.example: It is dangerous to swim here.（在这里游泳很危险。）

light_cards.hint: 基础词：女儿。联想 son 儿子、granddaughter 孙女
light_cards.example: Their daughter studies at a university.（他们的女儿在大学读书。）

light_cards.hint: economy（经济）+ -ic → 经济的。词组 economic growth 经济增长
light_cards.example: The country faces economic problems.（这个国家面临经济问题。）

light_cards.hint: educate（教育）+ -ed → 受过教育的。联想 well-educated 受过良好教育的
light_cards.example: He is a well-educated young man.（他是受过良好教育的年轻人。）

light_cards.hint: educate（教育）+ -ion → 教育。词组 higher education 高等教育
light_cards.example: Education is important for children.（教育对孩子很重要。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.失败，不及格；衰退，减弱 vt. (to)未能；使失望；没通过
light_cards.hint: 失败。词组 fail to do 未能做、fail the exam 考试不及格
light_cards.example: He failed to pass the exam.（他没能通过考试。）

light_cards.meaning: n.失败，不及格；失败者；没做到；失灵
light_cards.hint: fail（失败）+ -ure → 失败。联想 success 成功（反义）
light_cards.example: Failure is the mother of success.（失败是成功之母。）

light_cards.meaning: ad.公平地，公正地；相当，完全
light_cards.hint: fair（公平）+ -ly → 公平地；也引申"相当"
light_cards.example: The judge treated them fairly.（法官公平地对待他们。）

light_cards.hint: faith（信念、忠诚）+ -ful → 忠诚的。词组 be faithful to 忠于
light_cards.example: A dog is a faithful friend to man.（狗是人类忠实的朋友。）

light_cards.hint: 具体名词：车库。联想 car 车 + garage 车库（放车的地方）
light_cards.example: He parked his car in the garage.（他把车停进了车库。）

light_cards.meaning: n.花园，菜园 vi.从事园艺
light_cards.hint: 具体名词：花园。联想 gardener 园丁、gardening 园艺
light_cards.example: There are many flowers in the garden.（花园里有很多花。）

light_cards.meaning: a.普通的，通用的；总的，大体的 n.将军
light_cards.hint: 普通的、总的。词组 in general 一般来说、general idea 大意
light_cards.example: In general, the plan is a good one.（总的来说，这个计划不错。）

light_cards.hint: 基础词：一半。词组 half an hour 半小时、in half 分成两半
light_cards.example: It takes half an hour to get there.（到那里要半小时。）

light_cards.meaning: n.穿堂，门厅，大厅；会堂，礼堂；办公大楼
light_cards.hint: 具体名词：大厅。联想 school hall 学校礼堂、dining hall 食堂
light_cards.example: The meeting was held in the hall.（会议在大厅举行。）

light_cards.hint: il-（不）+ legal（合法的）→ 不合法的。联想 legal 合法的
light_cards.example: It is illegal to drive without a license.（无证驾驶是违法的。）

light_cards.hint: 具体名词：下巴。联想 mouth 嘴、teeth 牙齿都在 jaw 上
light_cards.example: He hurt his jaw in the accident.（他在事故中伤了下巴。）

light_cards.meaning: n.钥匙；答案，解答；键，琴键；方法，关键 a.主要的，关键的
light_cards.hint: 基础词：钥匙；关键的。词组 key to 关键、the key point 关键点
light_cards.example: Hard work is the key to success.（努力是成功的关键。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.杀死，消灭；破坏，毁灭；消磨（时间）
light_cards.hint: 基础词：杀死；消磨。词组 kill time 消磨时间
light_cards.example: They played cards to kill time.（他们打牌消磨时间。）

light_cards.hint: 语言。词组 foreign language 外语、native language 母语
light_cards.example: She can speak three languages.（她会说三种语言。）

light_cards.hint: 基础词：笑。词组 laugh at 嘲笑、burst into laughter 大笑
light_cards.example: The joke made everyone laugh.（这个笑话让大家都笑了。）

light_cards.hint: 具体名词：杂志。联想 newspaper 报纸、magazine 杂志
light_cards.example: She likes reading fashion magazines.（她喜欢读时尚杂志。）

light_cards.meaning: a.主要的，总的 n.总管道，干线
light_cards.hint: 主要的。词组 the main point 要点、main street 大街
light_cards.example: What is the main idea of this passage?（这篇文章的主旨是什么？）

light_cards.hint: manage（管理）+ -er（人）→ 经理
light_cards.example: He is the manager of the company.（他是这家公司的经理。）

light_cards.hint: 国家、民族。联想 national 国家的、international 国际的
light_cards.example: China is a great nation.（中国是个伟大的国家。）

light_cards.hint: 海军。联想 army 陆军、navy 海军、air force 空军
light_cards.example: He joined the navy when he was twenty.（他二十岁时加入了海军。）

light_cards.meaning: n.包装，包裹，箱；一揽子交易（或计划、建议等）
light_cards.hint: pack（打包）+ -age → 包裹。联想 parcel 包裹（同义）
light_cards.example: The package arrived this morning.（包裹今早到了。）

light_cards.hint: rail（铁轨）+ way（路）→ 铁路
light_cards.example: The railway connects the two cities.（这条铁路连接两座城市。）

light_cards.meaning: n.范围，距离，领域；排列，连续，（山)脉
light_cards.hint: 范围。词组 a wide range of 各种各样的、in the range of 在…范围内
light_cards.example: The shop sells a wide range of goods.（这家店卖各种各样的商品。）

light_cards.hint: satisfy（满足）+ -action → 满足。词组 with satisfaction 满意地
light_cards.example: He smiled with satisfaction.（他满意地笑了。）

light_cards.hint: 满足。词组 be satisfied with 对…满意
light_cards.example: The result satisfied everyone.（这个结果让每个人都满意。）

light_cards.hint: 调味汁。联想 soy sauce 酱油、tomato sauce 番茄酱
light_cards.example: She put some sauce on the noodles.（她在面条上放了点酱汁。）

light_cards.hint: 基础词：桌子；表格。词组 at table 在吃饭、time table 时间表
light_cards.example: The book is on the table.（书在桌子上。）

light_cards.hint: teach（教）+ -er（人）→ 教师
light_cards.example: Our teacher is very kind to us.（我们老师对我们很和蔼。）

light_cards.hint: under（在下面）+ stand（站）→ 站到下面看透 → 理解
light_cards.example: I don't understand this sentence.（我不理解这个句子。）

light_cards.meaning: [ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ] n.理解，理解力；谅解 a.能体谅人的，宽容的
light_cards.hint: understand（理解）+ -ing → 理解；宽容的
light_cards.example: Thank you for your understanding.（谢谢你的理解。）

light_cards.hint: under（在下面）+ wear（穿）→ 穿在里面的 → 内衣
light_cards.example: He bought some new underwear.（他买了些新内衣。）

light_cards.meaning: a.有价值的，贵重的 n. (pl.)贵重物品，财宝
light_cards.hint: value（价值）+ -able → 有价值的
light_cards.example: The watch is very valuable.（这块表很值钱。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.醒来，唤醒；使觉悟，激发，引起 vi.醒来
light_cards.hint: 基础词：醒来。词组 wake up 醒来、wake sb up 叫醒某人
light_cards.example: I usually wake up at six.（我通常六点醒。）

light_cards.hint: 基础词：墙。词组 on the wall 在墙上
light_cards.example: There is a picture on the wall.（墙上有一幅画。）

light_cards.hint: 一词多义：岸、银行。联想：河岸（river bank）像银行的柜台
light_cards.example: The house is on the bank of the river.（房子在河岸上。）

light_cards.meaning: n.战斗，战役，斗争 vi.战斗，战争，搏斗
light_cards.hint: 战斗。联想 war 战争（更大规模）、battle 战役（具体一场）
light_cards.example: They won the battle after a hard fight.（经过苦战他们打赢了这一仗。）

light_cards.hint: 海滩。联想 coast 海岸（更长）、beach 海滩（可游泳）
light_cards.example: We walked along the beach at sunset.（日落时我们沿海滩散步。）

light_cards.hint: 蛋糕。联想 birthday cake 生日蛋糕
light_cards.example: She made a cake for my birthday.（她为我做了个生日蛋糕。）

light_cards.hint: 帽子（有帽檐）。联想 hat 帽子（有边）、cap 便帽
light_cards.example: He wore a cap to protect his eyes from the sun.（他戴帽子遮阳。）

light_cards.meaning: vi. (with)处理，应付 vt.给予 n.交易，买卖；契约
light_cards.hint: 处理、交易。词组 deal with 处理、a great deal of 大量
light_cards.example: We must deal with this problem at once.（我们必须马上处理这个问题。）

light_cards.hint: 地球、土地。联想 on earth 究竟、the earth 地球
light_cards.example: The earth goes around the sun.（地球绕着太阳转。）

light_cards.hint: 事实。词组 in fact 事实上、as a matter of fact 事实上
light_cards.example: In fact, I know nothing about it.（事实上，我对此一无所知。）

light_cards.hint: 著名的。词组 be famous for 因…出名
light_cards.example: The city is famous for its old buildings.（这座城市以古老建筑闻名。）

light_cards.meaning: n.农场，农庄，牧场 vi.耕作，经营农场
light_cards.hint: 农场。联想 farmer 农民、farming 农业
light_cards.example: They grow vegetables on the farm.（他们在农场种蔬菜。）

light_cards.hint: general（一般的）+ -ly → 通常。词组 generally speaking 一般来说
light_cards.example: Generally speaking, the plan works well.（总的来说，这个计划运行良好。）

light_cards.hint: 几乎不（否定副词）。注意不是"努力地"，那是 hard
light_cards.example: I can hardly hear you.（我几乎听不见你说话。）

light_cards.hint: 伤害。词组 do harm to 对…有害
light_cards.example: Smoking does great harm to your health.（吸烟对健康危害很大。）

light_cards.hint: harm（伤害）+ -ful → 有害的。词组 be harmful to 对…有害

light_cards.hint: imagine（想象）+ -ary → 想象的、虚构的
light_cards.example: The story is about an imaginary world.（这个故事讲的是一个虚构的世界。）

light_cards.hint: 想象。词组 imagine doing 想象做、imagine that 想象…
light_cards.example: Can you imagine living on the moon?（你能想象住在月球上吗？）

light_cards.meaning: a.锋利，尖锐；敏捷，敏锐；(on)热心，渴望
light_cards.hint: 渴望的、敏锐的。词组 be keen on 热衷于
light_cards.example: She is keen on learning English.（她热衷于学英语。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.保持，坚持 vt.保留，保存；保持，继续；保守，遵守；防守，保卫； 抑制，防止；扣留，留住；赡养，饲养；经营，管理
light_cards.hint: 保持、继续。词组 keep doing 一直做、keep on 继续
light_cards.example: Keep quiet, please.（请保持安静。）

light_cards.hint: kilo（千）+ meter（米）→ 千米。联想 meter 米

light_cards.hint: 厨房。联想 cook 做饭的地方就是 kitchen

light_cards.hint: 湖。联想 river 河、sea 海、lake 湖
light_cards.example: We went boating on the lake.（我们在湖上划船。）

light_cards.hint: 小羊。联想 sheep 绵羊（大）、lamb 羔羊（小）
light_cards.example: The lamb is following its mother.（小羊跟着妈妈。）

light_cards.hint: 灯。联想 light 光、lamp 台灯/灯

light_cards.meaning: n.陆地；土地；国土，国家 vi./vt.(使）靠岸，（使）登陆，(使)着陆

light_cards.meaning: n.名字，名称；名声，名望；名义 vt.给……取名；列举；任命，提名

light_cards.example: What's your name?（你叫什么名字？）

light_cards.meaning: a.令人厌恶的；难弄的；恶劣的；污秽的

light_cards.example: The weather is nasty today.（今天天气很恶劣。）

light_cards.meaning: a.自然界的，天生的；天赋的，固有的

light_cards.hint: 服从。联想 obey the law 守法、disobey 违抗（反义）

light_cards.hint: 疼痛、痛苦。联想 painful 疼痛的、take pains 下功夫

light_cards.meaning: vt.涂，漆；画；绘，描述 n.油漆，颜料

light_cards.hint: paint（画）+ -ing → 绘画、油画

light_cards.example: I bought a pair of shoes.（我买了一双鞋。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.举起，提高，提升；增加；筹集；引起；抚养，饲养； 提出，发起

light_cards.hint: 沙。联想 sand beach 沙滩、sandy 沙的

light_cards.meaning: vt.救，拯救；储存，贮存；节省，节约

light_cards.meaning: vt.谈，讨论 vi.讲话，谈话，交谈 n.谈话，演讲，讲话

light_cards.meaning: vt.尝，品尝；体验，领略 vi.尝起来，吃起来 n.滋味；味觉；趣味；口味；鉴赏力

light_cards.meaning: a.技术的，工艺的；专门性，专业性的

light_cards.meaning: n.结合，组合，联合；协会，工会，联盟

light_cards.meaning: vi./vt.统一，结合，合并；联合，团结

light_cards.hint: 战争。联想 peace 和平（反义）

light_cards.meaning: n.暖和，温暖；热忱，热烈；保暖

light_cards.meaning: n.基（础），底（座）；基地 vt. (on)把……建立在……基础上

light_cards.hint: 篮子。联想 basketball 篮球（basket+ball）

light_cards.hint: 豆。联想 soya bean 大豆、bean 豆子

light_cards.example: We went camping by the river last summer.（去年夏天我们去河边露营。）

light_cards.hint: care（小心）+ -ful → 小心的。词组 be careful with 小心对待
light_cards.example: Be careful when you cross the road.（过马路时要小心。）

light_cards.meaning: a.每日的，日常的 ad.每日，天天 n. 日报

light_cards.meaning: vt.损害，毁坏 n.损害，毁坏；(pl.)损害赔偿费

light_cards.example: What's the date today?（今天几号？）

light_cards.hint: 耳朵。联想 hear 听（用 ear）

light_cards.hint: east（东）+ -ern → 东方的。联想 western 西方的
light_cards.example: The eastern part of China is near the sea.（中国东部靠近大海。）

light_cards.hint: 教育。联想 education 教育、educator 教育者

light_cards.hint: 工厂。联想 make 制造的地方就是 factory

light_cards.meaning: n.信任，信用；信念，信心；信仰
light_cards.hint: 信念、信任。词组 have faith in 相信
light_cards.example: We have faith in the future.（我们对未来有信心。）

light_cards.meaning: n.家，家庭；氏族，家族；系，族，属
light_cards.hint: 家庭。联想 family member 家庭成员

light_cards.hint: farm（农场）+ -er（人）→ 农民
light_cards.example: The farmer is working in the field.（农民正在田里干活。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.获得，赢得 vi.增加，增进；（钟表）走快 n.赢利；(pl.)收益，利润；增加，增进，获利

light_cards.meaning: vi.聚集，集合；收集，采集；逐渐增加
light_cards.hint: 聚集、收集。词组 gather together 聚集在一起
light_cards.example: The students gathered in the playground.（学生们在操场集合。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.吊，悬挂；吊死，绞死 vi.悬挂，吊着

light_cards.example: She hung the picture on the wall.（她把画挂在墙上。）

light_cards.hint: 冰。联想 ice cream 冰淇淋、icy 冰冷的
light_cards.example: The lake is covered with ice in winter.（冬天湖面结冰。）

light_cards.meaning: n.想法，念头；概念，观念；意见，主意
light_cards.hint: 想法。词组 have no idea 不知道、good idea 好主意
light_cards.example: I have a good idea.（我有个好主意。）

light_cards.hint: 忽视、不理。联想 i-（不）+ gnore（知道）→ 装作不知道 → 忽视
light_cards.example: Don't ignore the small problems.（不要忽视这些小问题。）

light_cards.meaning: a.有病的；坏的，恶意的 ad.坏，不利

light_cards.hint: ill（病）+ -ness → 疾病
light_cards.example: He missed school because of illness.（他因病缺课。）

light_cards.hint: imagine（想象）+ -ation → 想象力
light_cards.example: Children have rich imagination.（孩子们有丰富的想象力。）

light_cards.hint: 踢。词组 kick off 开球、kick out 赶出
light_cards.example: He kicked the ball into the goal.（他把球踢进了球门。）

light_cards.hint: 国王。联想 queen 王后、kingdom 王国
light_cards.example: The king ruled the country for many years.（这位国王统治国家多年。）

light_cards.hint: laugh（笑）+ -ter → 笑声

light_cards.meaning: a.疯的，神经错乱的；恼火的，狂怒的；狂热的， 着迷的
light_cards.hint: 疯的、狂怒的。词组 be mad at 生…的气、go mad 发疯
light_cards.example: He was mad at me for being late.（他因我迟到而生我的气。）

light_cards.meaning: n.钉；指甲，爪 vt.钉，使牢固
light_cards.hint: 指甲、钉子。一词多义：finger nail 指甲、nail 钉子
light_cards.example: She painted her nails red.（她把指甲涂成了红色。）

light_cards.hint: 狭窄的。联想 wide 宽的（反义）

light_cards.meaning: n.自然，自然界，性质，本性，天性

light_cards.example: We should protect nature.（我们应该保护自然。）

light_cards.meaning: n.犯罪，犯规，过错；冒犯，触怒
light_cards.hint: offend（冒犯）的名词 → 冒犯、犯规
light_cards.example: He apologized for his offence.（他为自己的冒犯道了歉。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.包装，打包；塞满，挤满 n.（一）包，（一）群，（一）幅
light_cards.hint: 打包、包裹。词组 pack up 收拾行李
light_cards.example: She packed her clothes into a bag.（她把衣服装进包里。）

light_cards.hint: 页。联想 turn the page 翻页
light_cards.example: Please turn to page ten.（请翻到第十页。）

light_cards.hint: 苍白的、浅的。联想 pale face 苍白的脸
light_cards.example: Her face turned pale with fear.（她吓得脸色发白。）

light_cards.hint: 雨、下雨。联想 rainy 多雨的

light_cards.meaning: a.稀有的，难得的，珍奇的；稀薄的，稀疏的

light_cards.example: This kind of bird is rare now.（这种鸟现在很稀有。）

light_cards.meaning: a.安全的，牢靠的 n.保险箱

light_cards.example: The children are safe at home.（孩子们在家很安全。）

light_cards.meaning: n.出卖，出售；贱卖，大减价；销数，销售

light_cards.hint: 尾巴。联想 head 头（相对）、tail 尾

light_cards.example: It takes two hours to get there.（到那里要花两小时。）

light_cards.example: There is something wrong with my bike.（我的自行车出问题了。）

light_cards.meaning: n.速度，速率；快，迅速 vi.急行，飞驰 vt.使加速

light_cards.example: The car was running at high speed.（汽车高速行驶。）

light_cards.example: The wheel spins very fast.（轮子转得很快。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.站立；坐落，位于；经受，忍受 n.台，座；货摊；置物架；看台，观众席；立场， 看法

light_cards.example: Please stand up when the teacher comes in.（老师进来时请起立。）

light_cards.hint: strong（强壮）的名词 → 力量

light_cards.hint: 猜想、假定。词组 be supposed to 应该
light_cards.example: I suppose he will come tomorrow.（我猜他明天会来。）

light_cards.meaning: n.诧异，惊奇 vt.使诧异，使惊奇；突然袭击

light_cards.hint: 发誓、咒骂。过去式 swore

light_cards.example: The storm threatened the small village.（暴风雨威胁着这个小村庄。）

light_cards.meaning: n.总数，合计 a.总的，完全的 vi.合计，总计
light_cards.hint: 总的、总数。词组 in total 总共

light_cards.hint: use（用）+ -less（无）→ 无用的

light_cards.hint: after（后）+ noon（中午）→ 午后、下午

light_cards.hint: 酒精。联想 alcoholic 含酒精的

light_cards.hint: 几乎。联想 nearly 几乎（同义）

light_cards.hint: 生气的。词组 be angry with sb 生某人的气

light_cards.meaning: n.平均，平均数 a.平均的；平常的，普通的

light_cards.hint: begin（开始）+ -ing → 开始。词组 at the beginning of 在…开始

light_cards.meaning: a.蓝色的；脸色发灰的；忧郁的 n.蓝色

light_cards.example: The sky is blue today.（今天天空很蓝。）

light_cards.hint: 靴子。联想 shoe 鞋、boot 靴

light_cards.meaning: a.忙，忙碌；热闹的，繁忙的，（电话）占线

light_cards.hint: 鸡、鸡肉。联想 egg 蛋、hen 母鸡

light_cards.meaning: a.明亮的，清澈的；晴朗的；清楚的 ad.清楚地，清晰地 vt.清除；澄清；晴朗起来
light_cards.hint: 清楚的、晴朗的。词组 make clear 弄清楚

light_cards.hint: 海岸。联想 beach 海滩、coast 海岸线

light_cards.hint: complete（完全的）+ -ly → 完全地

light_cards.hint: 玉米、谷物。联想 corn field 玉米地

light_cards.hint: 杯子。词组 a cup of tea 一杯茶
light_cards.example: I'd like a cup of coffee.（我想要杯咖啡。）

light_cards.meaning: a.坏的，邪恶的 n.邪恶，罪恶；祸害

light_cards.example: The story is about the fight between good and evil.（这个故事讲的是善恶之争。）

light_cards.hint: 确切的。词组 to be exact 确切地说

light_cards.meaning: a.坚固的，结实的，稳固的；坚定的 n.公司，商号

light_cards.example: He has a firm belief in himself.（他对自己有坚定的信念。）

light_cards.meaning: n.力，力量，力气；暴力，武力 vt.强迫，迫使

light_cards.hint: 谷物、颗粒。联想 grain 粮食

light_cards.hint: grand（隔代的）+ father（父）→ 祖父

light_cards.hint: 问候、迎接。联想 greeting 问候（名词）

light_cards.example: The box is too heavy to lift.（这个箱子太重了，抬不动。）

light_cards.hint: inter-（之间）+ national（国家的）→ 国际的

light_cards.meaning: vt. (in)卷入，陷入，连累；包含，含有

light_cards.meaning: n.工作，职业；一件工作，活儿

light_cards.meaning: n.审判员，法官；评判员，裁判 vt.评价，鉴定；断定，判断；审判，裁判，裁决

light_cards.hint: 数字、号码。词组 a number of 许多、phone number 电话号码

light_cards.hint: 意见。词组 in my opinion 在我看来

light_cards.example: We regard him as our best friend.（我们把他当作最好的朋友。）

light_cards.hint: 抢劫。词组 rob sb of sth 抢某人某物
light_cards.example: The man robbed the bank last night.（那人昨晚抢了银行。）

light_cards.hint: 玫瑰。联想 rose 玫瑰、lily 百合
light_cards.example: He gave her a red rose.（他送她一朵红玫瑰。）

light_cards.meaning: n.表演，节目；展出，陈列；展览会/物 vt.给（人）看，出示；带领；说明，示范；表明， 证明；指示，指出 vi.显示，露面；演出

light_cards.example: There are all sorts of books in the library.（图书馆里有各种书。）

light_cards.hint: 劈开、裂开。词组 split into 分成
light_cards.example: They split the cake into two parts.（他们把蛋糕分成两份。）

light_cards.meaning: vi./vt.拉长，延伸 n.拉长；伸展；连续的一段时间；一大片
light_cards.hint: 伸展、延伸。词组 stretch out 伸展

light_cards.hint: 喉咙。联想 sore throat 嗓子疼
light_cards.example: I have a sore throat today.（我今天嗓子疼。）

light_cards.hint: 卫生间。联想 bathroom 浴室、toilet 马桶/卫生间
light_cards.example: The toilet is at the end of the hall.（卫生间在走廊尽头。）

light_cards.meaning: n.麻烦，困难 vt.麻烦，打扰 vi.费神，费力

light_cards.example: He helped me out of trouble.（他帮我摆脱了麻烦。）

light_cards.meaning: n.类型；印刷字体；活字，铅字 vi./vt.打字
light_cards.hint: 类型、打字。词组 type of 类型
light_cards.example: This type of phone is very popular.（这种手机很流行。）

light_cards.hint: 参观、拜访。联想 visitor 游客、visit 参观

light_cards.hint: 财富。联想 rich 富的、wealthy 富有的
light_cards.example: Health is more important than wealth.（健康比财富更重要。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.称，量；重，重达；考虑，权衡 vi.重……
light_cards.hint: 称重、重达。联想 weight 重量（名词）
light_cards.example: The box weighs ten kilograms.（这个箱子重十公斤。）

light_cards.hint: 地区、面积、领域。词组 in the area of 在…领域

light_cards.hint: 文章、物件。联想 article 文章（报纸上的）
light_cards.example: He wrote an article for the newspaper.（他为报纸写了篇文章。）

light_cards.hint: 刷子、刷。词组 brush one's teeth 刷牙
light_cards.example: You should brush your teeth twice a day.（你应该每天刷两次牙。）

light_cards.hint: 黄油。联想 bread and butter 面包黄油（生计）
light_cards.example: She spread butter on the bread.（她在面包上抹黄油。）

light_cards.hint: 学院、大学。词组 go to college 上大学
light_cards.example: He will go to college next year.（他明年上大学。）

light_cards.hint: 梳子、梳理。联想 comb one's hair 梳头
light_cards.example: She combed her hair before the mirror.（她在镜子前梳头。）

light_cards.hint: compete（竞争）+ -ition → 竞赛。词组 in competition with 与…竞争
light_cards.example: He won the singing competition.（他赢得了歌唱比赛。）

light_cards.hint: computer 计算机。联想 compute 计算
light_cards.example: I use a computer to do my work.（我用电脑工作。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.（使）破裂，砸开；发爆裂声 n.裂纹，龟裂；爆裂声

light_cards.hint: 风俗、习惯。联想 customs 海关、custom 习俗

light_cards.hint: discuss（讨论）+ -ion → 讨论。词组 have a discussion 讨论
light_cards.example: We had a discussion about the plan.（我们就这个计划进行了讨论。）

light_cards.meaning: a.两倍的；双，双重 vt.使加倍，翻一番
light_cards.hint: 两倍的、双的。联想 single 单的、double 双的
light_cards.example: The price is double what it was.（价格是原来的两倍。）

light_cards.meaning: n.练习，习题；锻炼 vt.运用，行使，实行 vi.锻炼，训练
light_cards.hint: 锻炼、练习。词组 do exercise 锻炼、take exercise 锻炼
light_cards.example: Doing exercise is good for health.（锻炼有益健康。）

light_cards.meaning: n.闪光，一闪，闪光灯 vi.发闪光；闪现，闪过；飞驰，掠过
light_cards.hint: 闪光、闪现。词组 in a flash 一刹那
light_cards.example: Lightning flashed across the sky.（闪电划过天空。）

light_cards.meaning: vi./vt.飞，飞行；(放)风筝，驾驶(飞机)；(使)飘扬 n.苍蝇
light_cards.hint: 飞。过去式 flew。词组 fly a kite 放风筝
light_cards.example: The birds fly south in winter.（鸟儿冬天飞向南方。）

light_cards.meaning: n.框架；骨架，体格 vt.装框子
light_cards.hint: 框架。联想 picture frame 相框
light_cards.example: She put the photo in a frame.（她把照片放进相框。）

light_cards.hint: 朋友。词组 make friends with 与…交朋友
light_cards.example: He is my best friend.（他是我最好的朋友。）

light_cards.hint: 健康。词组 be in good health 身体健康
light_cards.example: Health is the most important thing.（健康是最重要的。）

light_cards.meaning: n.热；热烈，激烈 vt.加热 vi.发热
light_cards.hint: 热、加热。联想 cold 冷（反义）、hot 热的
light_cards.example: The sun gives us light and heat.（太阳给我们光和热。）

light_cards.hint: 洞、窟窿。联想 dig a hole 挖洞
light_cards.example: There is a hole in my sock.（我的袜子上有个洞。）

light_cards.hint: 昆虫。联想 in-（内）+ sect（切）→ 身体分节 → 昆虫
light_cards.example: Butterflies are beautiful insects.（蝴蝶是美丽的昆虫。）

light_cards.hint: 猴子。联想 monkey 猴子、ape 猿

light_cards.hint: near（近）+ -ly → 几乎、差不多

light_cards.hint: 经过、通过、传递。词组 pass the exam 通过考试

light_cards.hint: 暂停。联想 stop 停止、pause 暂停（短暂）

light_cards.hint: 和平、平静。词组 in peace 和平地、peaceful 和平的

light_cards.hint: 人。词组 in person 亲自
light_cards.example: He is a kind person.（他是个善良的人。）

light_cards.meaning: n.平原 a.平易的，易懂的；简单的，朴素的

light_cards.hint: power（力量）+ -ful → 强大的
light_cards.example: China is a powerful country.（中国是个强大的国家。）

light_cards.meaning: n.收益，利润，益处 vi.得利，获益
light_cards.hint: 利润、收益。词组 make a profit 获利
light_cards.example: The company made a big profit last year.（公司去年赚了很多利润。）

light_cards.hint: pronounce（发音）的名词 → 发音
light_cards.example: Her English pronunciation is very good.（她的英语发音很好。）

light_cards.hint: 女王、王后。联想 king 国王（相对）
light_cards.example: The queen was loved by her people.（女王深受人民爱戴。）

light_cards.meaning: vi./n.归，回；归还 vt.归还，送回；回报，报答 a.回程的；回报的
light_cards.hint: 归还、返回。词组 return to 回到、return...to 归还
light_cards.example: Please return the book to the library.（请把书还给图书馆。）

light_cards.meaning: vi./vt.摇，摇动；震动，颤抖；握手 n.摇动，震动，抖动

light_cards.example: They shook hands when they met.（他们见面时握手。）

light_cards.hint: 鞋。词组 a pair of shoes 一双鞋
light_cards.example: These shoes are too small for me.（这双鞋对我来说太小了。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.呼喊，呼叫 n.呼喊，叫声

light_cards.example: Don't shout at the children.（不要对孩子大喊大叫。）

light_cards.hint: 相似的。词组 be similar to 与…相似
light_cards.example: Your idea is similar to mine.（你的想法和我的相似。）

light_cards.hint: 楼梯。词组 go up the stairs 上楼
light_cards.example: She ran up the stairs quickly.（她飞快地跑上楼。）

light_cards.meaning: n.星，恒星；明星，名人 vi.主演

light_cards.example: The stars shine at night.（星星在夜晚闪耀。）

light_cards.hint: 胃。词组 stomach ache 胃痛
light_cards.example: He has a stomach ache.（他胃疼。）

light_cards.meaning: n.停车站；停止，中止 vt.停止，中止 vi.阻止；堵塞；逗留，歇宿
light_cards.hint: 停止、车站。词组 stop doing 停止做、stop to do 停下来去做
light_cards.example: The bus stops at the station.（公交车在车站停。）

light_cards.meaning: a.细的，薄的；稀的；瘦的 vi.变细，变薄

light_cards.example: The ice is too thin to skate on.（冰太薄不能滑。）

light_cards.meaning: n.跑道，路线，轨道；足迹，踪迹 vt.跟踪，追踪
light_cards.hint: 轨道、跟踪。词组 keep track of 追踪、track and field 田径
light_cards.example: The police tracked the thief.（警察追踪小偷。）

light_cards.meaning: n.管，软管；电子管，显像管；地铁
light_cards.hint: 管、地铁。词组 by tube 乘地铁（英式）
light_cards.example: He goes to work by tube.（他乘地铁上班。）

light_cards.hint: 综合性大学。联想 college 学院（比 university 小）
light_cards.example: She studies at a famous university.（她在一所著名大学学习。）

light_cards.meaning: n.选举，表决；选票，选票数 vi.选举，表决
light_cards.hint: 投票、选举。词组 vote for 投票支持
light_cards.example: People voted for the new president.（人们投票选新总统。）

light_cards.hint: warn（警告）+ -ing → 警告
light_cards.example: The weather station gave a warning of the storm.（气象台发布了暴风雨警报。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.观看，注视；窥伺，等待；看管，监视 n.表，手表；看管，监视
light_cards.hint: 一词多义：观看、手表。词组 watch TV 看电视
light_cards.example: We watch TV in the evening.（我们晚上看电视。）

light_cards.hint: 妻子。联想 husband 丈夫（相对）
light_cards.example: His wife is a doctor.（他妻子是医生。）

light_cards.hint: 值得。词组 be worth doing 值得做
light_cards.example: This book is worth reading.（这本书值得读。）

light_cards.meaning: n.成人 a.成年的，成熟的
light_cards.hint: 成年人。联想 child 孩子（反义）
light_cards.example: The movie is for adults only.（这部电影只适合成人。）

light_cards.meaning: ad.无论哪里；[否定、疑问、条件句中]任何地方
light_cards.hint: any（任何）+ where（地方）→ 任何地方
light_cards.example: You can sit anywhere you like.（你可以坐任何喜欢的地方。）

light_cards.hint: 军队。联想 soldier 士兵、army 军队
light_cards.example: He joined the army at eighteen.（他十八岁参军。）

light_cards.meaning: n.弯曲；曲折处 vt.折弯；使屈服
light_cards.hint: 弯曲。过去式 bent。词组 bend down 弯腰
light_cards.example: He bent down to pick up the pen.（他弯腰捡笔。）

light_cards.hint: 面包。词组 a piece of bread 一片面包
light_cards.example: I had bread and milk for breakfast.（我早餐吃面包和牛奶。）

light_cards.hint: 公交车。词组 by bus 乘公交、take a bus 坐公交
light_cards.example: He goes to school by bus.（他坐公交上学。）

light_cards.hint: 比较。词组 compare...with 把…与…比较
light_cards.example: Compare your answer with mine.（把你的答案和我的比较。）

light_cards.hint: 书桌。联想 table 桌子、desk 书桌
light_cards.example: The book is on the desk.（书在书桌上。）

light_cards.meaning: n.肘，弯头，弯管 vi.用肘推，挤进
light_cards.hint: 肘。联想 arm 手臂、elbow 肘
light_cards.example: He hurt his elbow playing basketball.（他打篮球时伤了肘。）

light_cards.hint: engine（引擎）+ -er → 工程师
light_cards.example: He works as an engineer.（他当工程师。）

light_cards.hint: explain（解释）+ -ation → 解释
light_cards.example: He gave a clear explanation.（他给出了清楚的解释。）

light_cards.hint: fashion（时尚）+ -able → 时髦的
light_cards.example: She always wears fashionable clothes.（她总穿时髦的衣服。）

light_cards.meaning: n.电影，胶卷；膜，薄层 vt.把……拍成电影
light_cards.hint: 电影、胶卷。词组 see a film 看电影
light_cards.example: We saw a film last night.（我们昨晚看了场电影。）

light_cards.hint: 花。联想 flower 花、garden 花园
light_cards.example: The garden is full of flowers.（花园里开满花。）

light_cards.hint: foot（脚）+ ball（球）→ 足球。词组 play football 踢足球
light_cards.example: The boys are playing football.（男孩们在踢足球。）

light_cards.hint: 货物、商品。联想 good 好的、goods 货物
light_cards.example: The shop sells many kinds of goods.（这家店卖很多商品。）

light_cards.hint: 家。词组 at home 在家、go home 回家
light_cards.example: I go home at five every day.（我每天五点回家。）

light_cards.hint: intend（打算）+ -tion → 意图。词组 have no intention of 无意
light_cards.example: He has no intention of leaving.（他无意离开。）

light_cards.meaning: vi.跳跃，跳动 n.跳跃；猛增
light_cards.hint: 跳。词组 jump over 跳过
light_cards.example: The cat jumped over the wall.（猫跳过墙。）

light_cards.hint: 嘴唇。联想 mouth 嘴、lip 唇

light_cards.hint: 听。词组 listen to 听（注意要加 to）
light_cards.example: Listen to the teacher carefully.（认真听老师讲。）

light_cards.hint: 锁。词组 lock the door 锁门、unlock 开锁（反义）
light_cards.example: Remember to lock the door.（记得锁门。）

light_cards.hint: mean（意味着）+ -ing → 意思、意义
light_cards.example: What's the meaning of this word?（这个单词什么意思？）

light_cards.meaning: a.显而易见的，显著的，值得注意的
light_cards.hint: notice（注意）+ -able → 显而易见的
light_cards.example: There is a noticeable change in him.（他有明显的变化。）

light_cards.meaning: n./a.外面（的），外部（的） ad.向外，在外 prep.在……外
light_cards.hint: out（外）+ side（边）→ 在外面。联想 inside 里面（反义）
light_cards.example: It's cold outside.（外面很冷。）

light_cards.hint: 欠、归功于。词组 owe...to 把…归功于
light_cards.example: I owe my success to my teacher.（我把成功归功于老师。）

light_cards.meaning: n.通过，经过；通路，走廊；段，节
light_cards.hint: pass（通过）+ -age → 段落、通道。词组 read the passage 读文章
light_cards.example: Read the passage and answer the questions.（读文章并回答问题。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.付款，缴纳；付清；给予，致以(问候),进行(访问) n.工资，薪饷；报酬
light_cards.hint: 支付。过去式 paid。词组 pay for 支付、pay attention to 注意
light_cards.example: He paid ten yuan for the book.（他花十元买这本书。）

light_cards.meaning: n.大头针；别针；销，栓 vt.钉住，别住
light_cards.hint: 别针、大头针。联想 pin 别针、pin up 别住
light_cards.example: She pinned the note on the board.（她把便条别在板上。）

light_cards.meaning: vi./vt.玩，游玩；演奏，表演；比赛 n.游戏，娱乐；剧本，戏剧；比赛，运动
light_cards.hint: 玩、打、演奏。词组 play football 踢球、play the piano 弹钢琴
light_cards.example: The children are playing in the park.（孩子们在公园玩。）

light_cards.hint: prepare（准备）+ -ation → 准备。词组 in preparation for 为…准备
light_cards.example: He is making preparations for the exam.（他在为考试做准备。）

light_cards.hint: 惩罚。词组 punish sb for 因…惩罚某人
light_cards.example: The teacher punished him for cheating.（老师因作弊惩罚他。）

light_cards.meaning: vt.收到，接到；接待，接见：受到，蒙受
light_cards.hint: 收到。联想 accept 接受（主观）、receive 收到（客观）
light_cards.example: I received a letter from him yesterday.（我昨天收到他的信。）

light_cards.meaning: vi. (to)参考，查阅，査询；(to)提到，引用，指
light_cards.hint: 提及、参考。词组 refer to 提到、参考
light_cards.example: He often refers to his notes.（他常参考笔记。）

light_cards.hint: 绳子。联想 string 细绳、rope 粗绳
light_cards.example: They tied the box with a rope.（他们用绳子捆箱子。）

light_cards.meaning: a.粗糙的；粗野的，粗鲁的；大致的，粗略的
